paper.title: Memory Decoder at Scale: A Pretrained, Parametric Long-Term Memory
paper.abstract: Decoder-only language models entangle long-term memory and reasoning in a single parameter set, making it difficult to scale memory capacity independently. Memory Decoder introduces a parametric long-term memory module but only studies it at a relatively small scale. In this work, we present Memory Decoder at Scale, scaling memory models up to 6.9B parameters and pretraining them on 300B tokens. At this data scale, the combined cost of indexing and search makes a standard Faiss pipeline infeasib

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是 decoder-only LM 中长期知识记忆和推理计算共享同一套参数的问题。标准做法只能通过扩大 backbone 或继续训练整个模型来增加知识容量，代价高，也容易带来遗忘和能力漂移。Memory Decoder 的思路是把长期记忆做成一个可独立预训练、可替换、可复用的参数化模块；这篇工作进一步回答一个关键问题：这种参数化 memory 在 300B token、数十亿参数规模上是否仍然有效，是否比单纯扩大 backbone 更有参数效率。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的价值在于，它把“知识容量如何扩展”从 backbone scaling 中拆出来了。实验显示，在固定或相近参数预算下，把更多参数分配给 memory，而不是全部放进基础模型，能获得更好的 benchmark 表现。这对 continual pretrain、领域适配和模块化 LM 都有直接启发：领域知识可以作为 memory 单独预训练并在推理时切换，而基础模型保持冻结，降低全模型继续训练的成本和风险。贡献量级不只是一个小模块实验，而是把 Memory Decoder 扩到 6.9B memory、300B token，并处理了大规模 kNN teacher 构建的工程瓶颈。需要注意的是，训练 memory 依赖非参数 kNN 分布作为教师，前处理成本很高；它提供的是一种更可控的参数分配路径，不等同于完全免费地增加知识。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。第一，冻结一个基础 LM，同时训练一个参数化 memory。memory 和 base model 接收同一上下文，各自产生 next-token distribution，推理时用线性插值合成最终分布：p_final = (1 - alpha) p_theta + alpha p_mem。这样 memory 不需要改写 backbone 参数，也可以在不同领域之间替换。第二，memory 的训练目标不是普通 next-token CE 单独驱动，而是对齐 kNN-LM 产生的非参数分布。图中给出的目标是 beta KL + (1 - beta) CE：KL 让 memory 学习检索器在局部邻域中给出的 token 分布，CE 保持语言建模信号，避免只做软标签蒸馏。和 RAG 不同，它推理时不再检索外部文本；和 kNN-LM 不同，它把检索分布压进参数里，换取更简单的推理路径。第三，工作重点处理了大规模 kNN teacher 的构建问题。对 deduplicated Pile 的 207B token 建索引和搜索时，常规 Faiss pipeline 不可行，因此使用 embedding compression、index sharding、parallel search 的分布式 Faiss 流水线；训练 general memory 时还用 sparse kNN distribution storage，只保存稀疏的邻居分布，并通过 distributed streaming 按 batch 读取所需条目，避免把完整 kNN 分布常驻内存或磁盘热路径。
summary.experiments: 主要结果集中在 general memory scaling 和 domain memory 两组实验。general memory 最大扩到 6.9B 参数，预训练数据为 300B token；kNN teacher 来自 deduplicated Pile 的 207B token。Pythia-410M 单独在 17 个 benchmark 上平均分为 29.86，接入 6.9B general memory 后升到 37.34，略高于 Pythia-12B 的 37.24，同时总参数少 39%。图 1 还显示，在多个规模点上，小 backbone 加大 memory 的组合，比只扩大 backbone 有更好的参数-性能折中。domain memory 方面，使用 1.7B 参数的领域 memory，搭配 Qwen3 Base 0.6B 到 14B 的多个 backbone，在 BioInst、LawBench、FinEval 三个领域平均提升均超过 9 分。对 Qwen3-14B-Base，三个领域分别给出约 17.96、8.97 等幅度的提升，说明 memory 不只对小模型有用，在较大 backbone 上仍能提供增益。更关键的实验信号是参数分配：同样增加参数，把参数放到可训练 memory 中，至少在这些任务上比继续扩大基础模型更划算。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读图 1、图 2、memory training objective、distributed Faiss pipeline、scaling results 和 domain memory 部分。图 1 是核心结论，直接展示 memory scaling 相对 backbone scaling 的参数效率。图 2 是方法入口，要看清楚 base model、memory、retriever teacher 和插值分布之间的关系。方法部分重点看 KL+CE 为什么组合使用，以及 alpha、beta 这类超参如何影响 memory 和 backbone 的分工。工程部分值得细读，因为 207B token 级别 kNN 分布构建是这类方法能否扩展的关键。实验部分应重点看 memory size、base size、general/domain memory、不同领域之间的消融；真正值得深挖的问题是 memory 学到的是可泛化知识分布，还是对 kNN teacher 的压缩近似，以及这种压缩在更强 backbone 上的边际收益如何变化。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息显示为清华大学电子工程系，并关联 LUMIA-Group/MemoryDecoder-at-Scale 与 Rubin-wei/MemoryDecoder-at-Scale 代码仓库。作者邮箱包含 weirubinn@gmail.com 和 lin.zhouhan@gmail.com；从给定内容无法完整确认作者列表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a structural limitation of decoder-only language models: long-term memory and reasoning are stored in the same parameter set. Increasing knowledge capacity usually means scaling the whole backbone or continuing to train all parameters, which is expensive and can cause forgetting or unintended capability shifts. Memory Decoder separates long-term memory into a pretrained, swappable parametric module. This work tests whether that idea still works at a more realistic pretraining scale: up to 6.9B memory parameters and 300B training tokens.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is the parameter-allocation result. The paper provides evidence that, under a comparable parameter budget, assigning parameters to an independently trained memory can be more efficient than putting all additional parameters into the backbone. This has direct implications for continual pretraining, domain adaptation, and modular language models. Domain knowledge can be trained as a separate memory and swapped at inference while the base model remains frozen. The contribution is not only architectural; it also shows how to build the kNN teacher distributions at 207B-token scale. A caveat is that the memory is trained from a non-parametric kNN teacher, so the offline indexing and search cost is substantial. The result should be read as a credible path for decoupling knowledge capacity from reasoning capacity, not as a cost-free replacement for backbone scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method combines a frozen base LM with a separately pretrained parametric memory. At inference, both modules process the same context and produce next-token distributions. The final prediction is an interpolation: p_final = (1 - alpha) p_theta + alpha p_mem. The memory is trained to imitate a kNN-LM distribution while retaining a standard next-token objective. The loss shown in the paper is beta KL + (1 - beta) CE: the KL term aligns the memory with the non-parametric retriever distribution, and the CE term preserves direct language-modeling supervision. Compared with RAG, the approach does not retrieve external passages at inference. Compared with kNN-LM, it compresses the retrieval distribution into parameters. The scaling work is enabled by a distributed Faiss pipeline with embedding compression, index sharding, and parallel search. For general memory pretraining, sparse kNN distribution storage and distributed streaming are used so that each batch only loads the required distribution entries.
summary_en.experiments: The largest general memory has 6.9B parameters and is pretrained on 300B tokens. The kNN teacher is built over the 207B-token deduplicated Pile. On 17 benchmarks, Pythia-410M alone scores 29.86 on average. With a 6.9B general memory, it reaches 37.34, slightly above Pythia-12B at 37.24 while using 39% fewer total parameters. Figure 1 also shows the same pattern across several scale points: a smaller backbone paired with a larger memory gives a better parameter-performance tradeoff than backbone-only scaling. For domain memory, 1.7B memories are paired with Qwen3 Base models from 0.6B to 14B. Across BioInst, LawBench, and FinEval, the average gain is more than 9 points at every backbone scale. On Qwen3-14B-Base, the reported domain gains include 17.96 and 8.97 points for two of the domains, indicating that the memory still helps even when the backbone is already large.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Figure 1, Figure 2, the memory training objective, the distributed Faiss pipeline, the scaling experiments, and the domain-memory experiments carefully. Figure 1 contains the central scaling claim. Figure 2 explains the mechanics: base model, memory, retriever teacher, and distribution interpolation. The method section is useful for understanding why KL alignment is paired with CE instead of using only next-token prediction or only teacher distillation. The systems section matters because the 207B-token kNN teacher is the practical bottleneck. In the experiments, focus on memory size versus backbone size, general versus domain memories, and ablations around interpolation and training objectives. The key question to keep in mind is whether the memory is learning broadly reusable knowledge distributions or mainly compressing the behavior of a particular kNN teacher.

The project is associated with LUMIA-Group/MemoryDecoder-at-Scale and Rubin-wei/MemoryDecoder-at-Scale. The visible emails include weirubinn@gmail.com and lin.zhouhan@gmail.com; the complete author list cannot be confirmed from the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你对“参数该给 backbone 还是给 memory”的 prior；先看 tradeoff 表和 retrieval 系统设计，再决定是否在内部做 memory-budget ablation。
recommendation.en: This can change your prior on whether extra parameters should go to the backbone or to memory; read the tradeoff tables and retrieval-system section first, then decide if a memory-budget ablation is worth running internally.

paper.title: Complexity-Guided Component-wise Initialization for Language Model Pretraining
paper.abstract: Pretrained language models often exhibit structured weight spectra, suggesting that training may repeatedly produce similar layerwise and component-wise organization. We ask whether these recurring spectral patterns can be reused as an initialization signal for GPT-2-style language-model pretraining. First, we analyze eleven pretrained GPT-2-style checkpoints that vary in size, language, tokenizer, and training corpus, measuring Frobenius norm and effective-rank entropy across layers and Transfo

summary.core_problem: 研究预训练 LM 中反复出现的权重谱结构，是否可以转化为 GPT-2 风格模型的更好初始化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是预训练初始化的负结果和结构分析。它有价值的部分不是新 initializer 本身，而是说明模仿已训练模型的层级谱形态并不自动带来性能收益。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先分析 11 个 GPT-2 风格 pretrained checkpoints，覆盖不同规模、语言、tokenizer 和语料，测量各层及 Transformer 子组件的 Frobenius norm 与 effective-rank entropy。随后构造 component-wise 初始化方案，模仿预训练模型的矩阵幅度和谱集中程度，并与多种常规初始化方法比较。
summary.experiments: 实验显示这些初始化确实改变了模型的结构性谱模式，尤其能植入类似预训练模型的 component-wise magnitude 和 spectral profile。但评测结果没有显示对应的性能优势，说明可见的谱结构不等于可迁移的初始化收益。摘要未给出具体参数规模和损失提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether recurring weight spectral structures in pretrained LMs can be reused as better initialization for GPT-2-style pretraining.
summary_en.importance: This is a pretraining initialization study with a useful negative result. The main value is not the proposed initializer, but the finding that imitating pretrained layerwise spectral profiles does not automatically improve downstream pretraining performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze eleven pretrained GPT-2-style checkpoints spanning different sizes, languages, tokenizers, and corpora. They measure Frobenius norm and effective-rank entropy across layers and Transformer subcomponents, then build component-wise initialization schemes that mimic pretrained magnitudes and spectral concentration patterns.
summary_en.experiments: The proposed initializers visibly alter the model's structural spectral patterns and can implant pretrained-like component-wise magnitudes and spectra. However, evaluation does not show a corresponding performance advantage over standard initialization baselines. The abstract does not provide detailed parameter sizes or numerical loss improvements.

recommendation.zh: 负结果比方法更有用；看谱分析图即可，别把 pretrained weight geometry 直接当初始化 recipe。
recommendation.en: The negative result is more useful than the method; inspect the spectral plots and avoid treating pretrained weight geometry as an initialization recipe.

paper.title: Modular Pretraining Enables Access Control
paper.abstract: AI developers face a dual-use dilemma. An AI capability that helps one user cure a disease can help another synthesize one. This dilemma could be resolved with access control, limiting dual-use AI capabilities to trusted deployments with a legitimate need. A gold standard for access control would be to serve separate models with different capabilities to different users. However, training and deploying multiple models is prohibitively expensive. To address this challenge, we propose gradient-rou

summary.core_problem: LLM 存在两用能力困境：同一类知识（如病毒学、网络安全、核物理）既可以产生正向价值，也可被滥用。理想的访问控制方案是为不同用户训练并部署多个能力不同的独立模型，但在前沿规模下，多次预训练和多模型部署的成本不可接受；现有替代方案（拒绝训练、输出过滤、事后遗忘、LoRA 分支微调）要么无法从参数层面真正移除能力，容易被对抗诱导或少量微调恢复，要么容量不足以承载预训练级别的能力学习。
summary.importance: 提出了一种在单次预训练内同时构造多种能力剖面的模块化预训练范式，把「能力隔离」从后处理问题前移到预训练阶段，直接改变了能力在模型参数中的分布方式。对预训练研究的具体影响包括：1）给出了一种低成本近似「数据过滤式多模型训练」的路径，能力移除效果接近从头过滤数据训练的金标准，显著优于事后遗忘；2）证明能力隔离效果随模型规模扩大而增强，在 50M–5B 参数范围内与数据过滤的能力剖面高度一致，具备向更大模型扩展的潜力；3）在部分标注数据场景下，能力移除效果显著优于数据过滤和分支微调，为现实中难以完全标注的两用数据提供了可行方案。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 Gradient-Routed Auxiliary Modules（GRAM）。1）结构改造：在稠密 Transformer 的每个 MLP 层旁，额外挂载若干个较小的辅助 MLP 模块，每个模块对应一种目标能力域；主干 MLP 对应通用核心能力。2）训练路由：根据当前 batch 所属的数据域，选择性开启对应模块的前向与反向传播——核心数据只更新主干，某一辅助域数据同时更新主干和对应辅助模块，梯度不会流向不相关的辅助模块。本质上是把「数据域」映射到「参数子空间」，让不同能力的学习被物理隔离到不同参数块中。3）推理控制：推理时直接剔除（ablate）某个辅助模块，即可移除对应能力，无需重新训练；组合启用不同模块即可得到任意能力子集的模型变体。GRAM 结合了三类已有思路：域特定模块、数据依赖的选择性梯度更新、参数子集的独立优化，但首次把它们组合成面向能力访问控制的完整预训练流程。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖合成数据与真实两用数据，参数量从 50M 到 5B，对比基线包括数据过滤（金标准）、模型分支、LoRA 分支微调、事后遗忘。1）Simple Stories 合成数据集：GRAM 在能力保留与移除两个维度上，与数据过滤基线几乎重合。2）800M 参数真实数据实验：核心数据集为网页文本、代码、arXiv 论文，辅助域为病毒学、网络安全、核物理、Lisp 代码。核心任务性能接近全数据训练基线；辅助域的能力保留与移除效果与数据过滤、FT-LoRA 持平；移除能力后对恶意微调的抵抗能力显著优于事后遗忘，接近数据过滤水平；同时启用多个辅助模块不会互相干扰，支持任意能力子集组合。3）部分标注数据场景：GRAM 的能力移除效果远好于数据过滤和分支微调。4）缩放实验：在 50M–5B 的计算最优模型区间内，GRAM 的能力剖面与数据过滤高度一致，且对目标能力的抑制效果随规模扩大而增强。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 节方法部分，理解 GRAM 的路由规则与参数更新机制，特别是「哪些梯度流向哪些模块」的精确设计；关注第 5 节真实数据实验中对「恶意微调抵抗能力」的评测设置与数值对比，这是区分 GRAM 与事后遗忘的关键证据；第 6 节缩放实验的曲线值得细看，它直接回答了该方法能否扩展到前沿模型规模；附录中的消融实验（辅助模块大小、路由粒度、优化器配置）对复现和工程落地有直接参考价值。值得深挖的点包括：辅助模块的容量与能力隔离质量的 scaling 关系、路由标签噪声下的鲁棒性、是否可以扩展到非离散的能力维度、以及与 MoE 路由机制的本质差异。
summary.authors_note: AE Studio、Independent、Anthropic；共同一作为 Ethan Roland 等。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs exhibit a dual-use dilemma: knowledge domains such as virology, cybersecurity, and nuclear physics enable both beneficial and harmful applications. The gold standard for access control is to train and deploy separate models with distinct capability profiles for different user groups, but multiple full pretraining runs and deployments are prohibitively expensive at frontier scale. Existing cheaper alternatives — refusal training, output filtering, post-hoc unlearning, and parameter-efficient branched finetuning — either fail to remove capabilities at the parameter level (and are thus vulnerable to adversarial elicitation or recovery via light finetuning) or lack the capacity to learn pretraining-scale capabilities.
summary_en.importance: GRAM introduces a modular pretraining paradigm that constructs multiple capability profiles within a single pretraining run, shifting capability isolation from post-processing into the pretraining stage itself and physically separating different capabilities into distinct parameter subspaces. For pretraining research, this work makes three concrete contributions. First, it provides a low-cost approximation to gold-standard data-filtered multi-model training, with capability removal quality close to that of models trained on filtered data and substantially better than post-hoc unlearning. Second, it shows that isolation quality improves with model scale: across 50M to 5B compute-optimal models, GRAM closely matches the capability profiles of data-filtered baselines, suggesting viability at larger scales. Third, it outperforms both data filtering and branched finetuning under partially labeled data, a realistic setting where dual-use corpora cannot be perfectly annotated.
summary_en.technical_approach: Gradient-Routed Auxiliary Modules (GRAM) has three core components. (1) Architecture: each MLP layer in a dense Transformer is augmented with several smaller auxiliary MLP modules, each dedicated to one target capability domain, while the main MLP handles general core capabilities. (2) Training routing: forward and backward passes for auxiliary modules are selectively enabled based on the domain of the current batch. Core data updates only the backbone; data from a specific auxiliary domain updates both the backbone and the corresponding auxiliary module; gradients never flow to unrelated auxiliary modules. This design maps data domains to parameter subspaces, physically isolating the learning of different capabilities. (3) Inference control: ablating an auxiliary module at inference time removes its corresponding capability without retraining; enabling arbitrary subsets of modules produces arbitrary capability profiles from a single deployed model. GRAM combines domain-specific modules, data-dependent selective gradient updates, and per-subset optimizers into an end-to-end pretraining recipe for access control.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments span synthetic and realistic dual-use datasets, scale from 50M to 5B parameters, and compare against data filtering (gold standard), model branching, FT-LoRA, and post-hoc unlearning. (1) On the Simple Stories synthetic dataset, GRAM closely matches data filtering on both capability retention and removal. (2) In the 800M-parameter realistic setting, the core corpus is web text + code + arXiv papers, with four auxiliary domains: virology, cybersecurity, nuclear physics, and Lisp code. GRAM matches the all-data baseline on core tasks; matches data filtering and FT-LoRA on auxiliary retention and removal; resists malicious finetuning on removed domains substantially better than post-hoc unlearning, approaching the robustness of data filtering. Enabling multiple auxiliary modules does not cause mutual interference. (3) Under partially labeled data, GRAM achieves far better capability removal than both data filtering and branched finetuning. (4) Across 50M–5B compute-optimal models, GRAM's capability profiles closely track data filtering, and suppression of the target forget capability strengthens with scale.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the precise routing rules and parameter update mechanics — the exact specification of which gradients flow to which modules is the core of the method. Section 5's evaluation of robustness against malicious finetuning contains the most critical evidence distinguishing GRAM from post-hoc unlearning. Section 6's scaling curves directly address whether the approach extends to frontier model sizes. Ablations in the appendix on auxiliary module capacity, routing granularity, and optimizer configuration are directly useful for reproduction and engineering deployment. Worth deeper investigation: the scaling relationship between auxiliary module capacity and isolation quality, robustness to label noise in routing, extension to non-discrete capability dimensions, and the fundamental differences between GRAM routing and MoE routing.
summary_en.authors_note: AE Studio, Independent, Anthropic; equal contribution led by Ethan Roland et al.

recommendation.zh: 预训练阶段做能力模块化的思路很干净，立刻可在内部安全对齐实验中复现模块路由设计。
recommendation.en: The capability modularization during pretraining is cleanly designed; immediately reproduce the module routing setup in internal safety-alignment ablations.

summary.core_problem: 揭示化学语言模型在预训练和微调阶段对分子子结构的编码规律与表征变化机制
summary.importance: 领域专用LM的表征机制分析工作，可迁移参考通用LLM的预训练-微调表征演化研究方法
summary.technical_approach: 设计78种分子子结构探测任务，系统对比8个预训练CLM与6个随机初始化模型的各层表征，再分析两个化学下游任务微调前后的表征差异
summary.experiments: 覆盖预训练/随机初始化共14个模型，探测78种子结构；发现预训练主要提升上层的结构感知能力，随机初始化模型首层已能较好编码环结构，微调优先改变任务相关子结构的表征

summary_en.core_problem: Reveal encoding patterns of molecular substructures and representation evolution mechanisms of chemical language models during pretraining and fine-tuning
summary_en.importance: Representation mechanism analysis for domain-specific LMs, with transferable probing methodology for general LLM pretrain-finetune representation evolution studies
summary_en.technical_approach: Design 78 molecular substructure probing tasks, systematically compare layer-wise representations across 8 pretrained CLMs and 6 randomly initialized models, then analyze representation changes before and after fine-tuning on two chemical downstream tasks
summary_en.experiments: Covers 14 models total, probes 78 substructure types; finds pretraining mainly improves structure awareness in upper layers, randomly initialized models already encode ring structures well in the first layer, fine-tuning preferentially alters representations of task-relevant substructures

recommendation.zh: 化学领域LM的表征探测工作，方法学可参考用于通用LLM预训练-微调的层间表征演化分析，作为literature备查即可
recommendation.en: Probing work for domain-specific chemical LMs; methodology is referenceable for general LLM pretrain-finetune layer-wise representation evolution analysis, keep as literature reference only

summary.core_problem: 这项工作关注重复块网络的优化问题：Transformer、ResNet 这类模型在深度方向上会形成层间相似性，但常规优化器仍把每一层的参数更新近似独立处理，没有显式利用这种深度结构。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把“层间耦合”从表征分析推进到优化器更新规则。方法不改模型结构，也不依赖特定优化器，可以接在 Adam、AdamW、Muon、SGD 等更新之后。对于大模型训练，这类后处理式优化增强的吸引力在于工程侵入较小，可能改善训练稳定性、收敛速度和泛化，但需要在更大规模预训练上验证收益是否能保持。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Depth-wise Gradient Augmentation：先由基础优化器为每个重复块产生 block-wise update，然后沿深度维度对这些更新做变换，再把变换后的更新应用到各层。具体实例是 Gradient Smoothing，尤其是 Window Smoothing：每一层的更新不只来自自身，而是与邻近若干层的优化器更新做局部平均。关键点是平滑对象是“优化器产生的 update”，不是原始梯度，因此它可以叠加在 Adam 的自适应更新、Muon 的矩阵更新或普通 SGD 之后。方法可被理解为一种块结构参数空间上的预条件器：假设相邻层的学习动态存在相关性，就用局部平滑降低层间更新噪声，并鼓励深度方向上的表示演化更连续。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖语言模型预训练、LLM 推理任务的 RL fine-tuning、Vision Transformer 监督训练和 diffusion model 训练。作者报告 Gradient Smoothing 在这些设置中能改善优化和泛化，并观察到更强的 layer-wise trajectory alignment 与 representation residual similarity。消融重点围绕不同基础优化器、局部窗口平滑以及层间表示结构变化。提供内容中没有给出具体表格数字、参数规模、训练 token 数或提升幅度，因此不应把结论外推为大规模 LLM 训练已验证。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。优先看方法定义部分，确认 update-level smoothing 的数学形式，以及它和直接平滑梯度、跨层参数共享、layer tying 的区别。其次看实验中语言模型预训练和 RL fine-tuning 的设置，因为这两部分最接近基座训练问题。表示分析部分也值得扫读，重点看 trajectory alignment 和 residual similarity 是否只是相关现象，还是能解释优化收益。若要复现实验，需重点检查窗口大小、边界层处理、是否平滑 attention/MLP 全部块参数、non-block 参数如何处理，以及与 AdamW/Muon 状态更新的先后顺序。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies an optimization gap in repeated-block networks. Transformers and ResNets develop structured relationships across depth during training, but standard optimizers still construct and apply per-layer updates largely independently.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance for pretraining is that it turns layer coupling from an analysis observation into an optimizer-side intervention. The method does not change the architecture and can be placed after common optimizers such as Adam, AdamW, SGD, or Muon. This makes it engineering-light compared with architectural changes. For large-scale pretraining, the open question is whether the reported gains survive at larger model and token scales, especially under tightly tuned optimizer recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Depth-wise Gradient Augmentation. A base optimizer first produces block-wise updates for all repeated layers. A depth-wise operator then transforms this collection of updates before applying them to the model. The concrete instantiation is Gradient Smoothing, with Window Smoothing as the simplest operator: each layer receives a local average of optimizer updates from neighboring layers. The smoothing is applied to optimizer updates rather than raw gradients, which is why the method can be composed with adaptive optimizers and matrix-based optimizers. Conceptually, it behaves like a structured preconditioner over a block-structured parameter space, using the assumption that nearby layers often follow related learning dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments span language model pretraining, RL fine-tuning of LLMs for reasoning, supervised Vision Transformer training, and diffusion model training. The paper reports consistent improvements in optimization and generalization, together with stronger layer-wise trajectory alignment and higher residual representation similarity across depth. The provided content does not include exact table values, parameter counts, token budgets, or improvement magnitudes, so the evidence should be read as promising but not yet sufficient to settle large-scale LLM pretraining behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Start with the formal definition of Depth-wise Gradient Augmentation and Window Smoothing, focusing on the distinction between update smoothing and gradient smoothing. Then inspect the language model pretraining and RL fine-tuning experiments, since these are closest to foundation-model training. The representation analysis is worth reading to see whether alignment metrics plausibly explain the optimization gains. For implementation, pay attention to window size, boundary handling, whether attention and MLP parameters are smoothed together or separately, how non-block parameters are treated, and whether optimizer states are updated before or after smoothing.

recommendation.zh: 一种非常简单但有效的 trick，利用了 Transformer 层间的相似性进行梯度平滑，建议在内部 pretrain 实验中快速验证其对收敛速度的提升。
recommendation.en: A simple yet effective trick that leverages inter-layer similarity in Transformers for gradient smoothing; worth a quick validation in internal pretrain runs for convergence speedup.

paper.title: Scaling Laws, Carefully
paper.abstract: Scaling laws are one of the most critical empirical findings in deep learning. The observation is simple in form: the training loss $L$ decreases predictably as we scale up model size $N$, dataset size $D$, and compute $C$, following a power-law curve, which appears as a straight line on a log-log plot. We can view scaling laws as a framework for describing the relationship between compute, loss, model size and data; at its core, it is about how to allocate precious compute optimally between

summary.core_problem: 这篇长文要解决的不是提出一个新 scaling law，而是把语言模型 scaling law 里最容易被误读的几件事讲清楚：一，Kaplan 与 Chinchilla 为什么会得出不同的 compute-optimal 结论；二，现实里应该怎样拟合 loss–model–data–compute 的关系，哪些拟合方法会系统性地产生偏差；三，power law 现象到底是在什么区间内成立，什么时候会因为数据不足、不可约误差或实验设计问题而失真。全文的重点不是复述结论，而是解释“为什么同样看起来合理的实验流程，会把最优参数/最优 token 配比估错很多”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在方法论层面。它把 scaling law 从一句经验口号，拆成了可操作的实验设计问题：如何选点、如何控制 token budget、如何做 IsoFLOP 曲线、如何做参数化拟合、如何识别 data-limited 区域、如何避免把未收敛训练误当成 compute-optimal 规律。对做大模型配比、token 预算、mid-train 继续训练、数据再利用的人，这类澄清比再看一遍 Kaplan 或 Chinchilla 原文更直接。贡献量级不是“提出新定律”，而是把已有定律的适用条件、冲突来源和工程陷阱讲透，属于高质量研究笔记。
summary.technical_approach:
文章先从更早的学习曲线工作讲起，包括 Amari、Hestness、Rosenfeld 等，目的是说明 power law 并不是 LLM 时代突然出现的现象，而是更一般的误差—容量—数据关系在现代深度学习中的经验化表达。随后进入 Kaplan 体系：分别考察 test loss 对参数量 N、数据量 D、计算量 C 的幂律关系，并强调联合形式里过拟合程度主要由 N^(alpha/beta)/D 这样的比例控制。这一步的关键是，Kaplan 的结论建立在当时的实验覆盖范围和拟合方式上，因此会把 compute-optimal 点推向“更大的模型、相对更少的 token”。

接着文章详细拆解 Chinchilla 的三种方法。Method 1 是固定模型大小、扫描 token budget，看每个模型在不同训练 token 下的最优点；Method 2 是 IsoFLOP profiles，在固定总计算预算下比较不同 N–D 组合；Method 3 是直接对联合损失函数做参数化拟合。作者强调，三种方法并不是简单替代关系，而是各自对不同误差源敏感：固定模型扫 token 更容易看清 undertraining；IsoFLOP 更贴近真实 compute allocation；参数化拟合最省实验，但对函数形式和采样区域很敏感。

文章一个很有用的部分是“现实中的拟合陷阱”。它指出，如果实验点主要落在 data-infinite 或 model-limited 的局部区域，拟合出来的指数会带明显偏差；如果把尚未充分训练的点混入拟合，或者用过窄的模型/数据范围外推，最后得到的 compute-optimal 配比会系统性偏向大模型欠训练方案。文中用 toy simulation 说明：即便底层真实规律已知，只要采样区域和噪声结构不合适，拟合出的指数也会稳定地错。这个分析解释了为什么 Kaplan 与 Chinchilla 的差异不只是“新论文推翻旧论文”，而是实验设计与拟合视角不同导致的估计偏移。

最后，文章讨论为什么会出现 power law。这里没有给出严格理论证明，而是把它放回更一般的统计学习与经验现象中：在远离饱和区和极小规模区时，很多误差项会表现出近似尺度不变性，因此在 log-log 坐标下呈线性。这个部分更像解释框架，而不是封闭理论。
summary.experiments:
这不是原始实验论文，重点不在发布新 benchmark 数字，而在复盘已有结果与拟合方法。文中回顾了 Kaplan 2020 的关键实验设定：Transformer LM，模型规模约从 7.68 亿到 15 亿非 embedding 参数，数据规模从 2200 万到 230 亿 token，使用 3000 step warmup 加 cosine decay。Kaplan 的核心结论之一是 compute-optimal 下 N_opt ∝ C^0.73，因此 10 倍算力应把模型放大约 5.5 倍、token 只增约 1.8 倍。文章指出这正是后来被 Chinchilla 修正的地方，因为该指数会导致模型明显欠训练。

对 Chinchilla 部分，文章强调其结论是更接近“参数量与训练 token 近似同阶增长”的 compute-optimal 配比，也就是在固定算力下应训练更小但更充分的数据覆盖模型。虽然这里给出的全文摘录没有展开全部具体数字，但核心实验洞察很明确：当你真正扫描 token budget 或做 IsoFLOP 比较时，很多 Kaplan 风格的大模型点并没有训练到合适区域，因此最优点被高估到过大的 N。

最有信息量的“实验”其实是 toy simulation。它展示了拟合流程本身会制造偏差：即使真实损失函数已知，只要观测点集中在局部区间、噪声存在、或拟合形式过强，外推出的 scaling exponent 和最优配比都可能明显偏离真实值。对做内部 scaling study 的团队，这个结论比单个指数更重要。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议抓四块内容。第一块是 Kaplan 与 Chinchilla 两节，先看它们各自到底测了什么、最优点是怎么定义的。第二块是 Chinchilla 的三种方法，尤其是 Method 1 和 Method 2，这两部分最接近实际做配比实验时的决策流程。第三块是“Trickiness of Fitting Scaling Laws in Reality”和 toy simulation，这部分最值得看，因为它直接对应工程里最常见的误判来源。第四块是 Why power law，可快速浏览，把它当作背景解释即可。

如果已经熟悉 Kaplan/Chinchilla 原文，预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主要信息；如果正在设计新的 scaling 实验，建议把拟合陷阱和采样区间分析细看一遍，并对照自己当前的 sweep 设计检查是否存在 data-limited、undertrained 或外推过远的问题。
summary.authors_note: Lilian Weng，OpenAI。长期写作与整理大模型训练、对齐、agent、scaling 等方向的技术长文，背景横跨研究与技术传播。

summary_en.core_problem: The piece is not proposing a new scaling law. It is clarifying three things that are easy to get wrong in practice: why Kaplan and Chinchilla reached different compute-optimal prescriptions, how scaling-law fitting should actually be done under realistic constraints, and where the apparent power-law regime breaks because of data limitation, irreducible error, or flawed experimental design. The central question is: how can seemingly reasonable small-scale studies produce badly biased recommendations for model/data allocation at large scale?
summary_en.importance: Its value is methodological rather than algorithmic. It turns scaling laws from a slogan into an experimental discipline: how to choose sweep points, how to vary token budgets, how to use IsoFLOP profiles, how to fit joint loss surfaces, and how to detect when a regime is data-limited or undertrained. For pretraining researchers working on compute allocation, token budgeting, continued pretraining, or data reuse, this is more useful than a surface-level recap of Kaplan or Chinchilla. The contribution is not a new law, but a careful account of applicability, failure modes, and fitting bias.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The article starts from older learning-curve literature, including Amari, Hestness, and Rosenfeld, to make the point that power-law behavior predates modern LLMs. In that framing, scaling laws are empirical descriptions of how error changes with capacity, data, and compute. It then revisits Kaplan et al.: test loss scales as a power law with parameter count N, dataset size D, and compute C, and the joint form implies that overfitting is largely controlled by a ratio like N^(alpha/beta)/D. The important caveat is that Kaplan’s compute-optimal recommendation depends on the experimental range and fitting procedure, which pushed the optimum toward larger models trained on relatively fewer tokens.

The Chinchilla section is the core. It breaks down three fitting strategies. Method 1 fixes model size and varies the token budget to identify the best token count per model. Method 2 uses IsoFLOP profiles, comparing different N–D allocations under fixed total compute. Method 3 fits a parametric joint loss function directly. The article explains why these are not interchangeable: token sweeps reveal undertraining more directly, IsoFLOP studies align better with real compute allocation, and parametric fits are efficient but sensitive to functional assumptions and sampling coverage.

A particularly useful part is the discussion of fitting pitfalls. If experiments are concentrated in a narrow region, especially one that is effectively data-infinite or strongly model-limited, the fitted exponents can be systematically biased. If partially trained runs are treated as if they reflected compute-optimal behavior, the resulting recommendation will favor oversized, undertrained models. The toy simulation makes this concrete: even when the ground-truth law is known, limited coverage and noise can produce stable but wrong exponents. That is the real reconciliation between Kaplan and Chinchilla: not a simple contradiction, but different estimation procedures operating under different regimes.

The final section on why power laws appear is interpretive rather than formal. It argues that away from tiny-scale and saturation regimes, many error terms behave approximately scale-free, which makes log-log linearity empirically robust.
summary_en.experiments:
This is a synthesis article rather than a new empirical paper, so the emphasis is on reinterpreting existing results and fitting procedures. It revisits Kaplan 2020: Transformer language models with roughly 768M to 1.5B non-embedding parameters, datasets from 22M to 23B tokens, trained with 3k-step warmup and cosine decay. One key Kaplan conclusion was N_opt ∝ C^0.73, implying that a 10x compute increase should scale model size by about 5.5x but tokens by only about 1.8x. The article highlights that this is exactly the recommendation later corrected by Chinchilla because it leaves models substantially undertrained.

For Chinchilla, the main takeaway is that compute-optimal scaling is much closer to growing parameters and training tokens in the same rough order, meaning smaller models trained on more data under a fixed compute budget. The excerpt provided here does not enumerate every number from the original Chinchilla study, but the experimental lesson is clear: once token sweeps or IsoFLOP comparisons are done carefully, many Kaplan-style large-model points are revealed to be undertrained, which shifts the optimum toward more tokens and fewer parameters.

The most informative “experiment” in the article is the toy simulation. It shows that the fitting pipeline itself can create bias: narrow sampling ranges, noise, and overly rigid parametric assumptions can all distort the inferred exponent and the downstream compute-optimal prescription. For anyone running internal scaling studies, that lesson matters more than any single fitted exponent.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on four parts. First, read the Kaplan and Chinchilla sections to understand what each study actually measured and how each defined optimality. Second, read the three Chinchilla methods, especially Method 1 and Method 2, because they map most directly to practical compute-allocation studies. Third, spend time on “Trickiness of Fitting Scaling Laws in Reality” and the toy simulation; that is the most practically useful section because it explains where teams usually fool themselves. Fourth, the “Why power law?” section can be read quickly as background.

If you already know the original Kaplan and Chinchilla papers, 20–30 minutes is enough to extract the main value. If you are designing a new scaling sweep, read the fitting-pitfall discussion carefully and compare it against your own sampling plan to check for data-limited regions, undertrained runs, or overly aggressive extrapolation.
summary_en.authors_note: Lilian Weng, OpenAI. Known for technically careful long-form writing on scaling, alignment, agents, and modern LLM training topics.

recommendation.zh: 把 Kaplan 与 Chinchilla 的指数分歧讲成估计问题而非结论之争——0.73 与 0.5 的差来自采样区间、是否把 embedding 参数计入、以及把欠训练的点当成 compute-optimal。做内部 scaling sweep 前，值得对照文中的拟合陷阱和 toy simulation 自查一遍；这是目前对“为什么 scaling law 会拟错”最清楚的梳理。
recommendation.en: Reframes the Kaplan-vs-Chinchilla exponent gap (0.73 vs 0.5) as an estimation artifact—sampling range, whether embeddings are counted, and treating undertrained runs as compute-optimal—rather than a clash of conclusions. Before any internal scaling sweep, check your fit against its pitfalls and the toy simulation; it is the clearest account of why scaling-law fits go wrong.

paper.title: Tying the Loop -- Tied Expert Layers in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures efficiently scale Large Language Models (LLMs) by activating only a small fraction of their experts per token, yet the full parameter count - dominated by the expert parameters - must be held in training and inference memory. To address this, we introduce Expert Tying, an architectural modification that shares expert parameters across consecutive transformer layers while preserving independent, layer-wise routing and attention.   We evaluate this approach a

summary.core_problem: MoE架构通过每token仅激活少量专家FFN，实现了总参数量与每token计算量的解耦，成为大模型扩展的主流方案；但当前开源MoE的每token激活参数占比仅3%-10%，训练和推理时仍需加载全部专家参数，显存几乎被闲置参数主导，这与近期追求“单参数计算效率最大化”的趋势（如循环深度模型、OpenAI Parameter Golf挑战）直接矛盾。此外，现有MoE跨层参数共享工作未通过控制变量实验系统分析各组件（专家FFN、路由、注意力、归一化）共享的质量代价，无法指导最优共享策略设计。
summary.importance: 提供了可直接落地的MoE参数效率优化方案，无需修改现有训练/推理基础设施即可大幅降低显存占用。通过系统的控制变量实验厘清了MoE各组件跨层共享的质量代价差异，为后续参数高效MoE、循环深度架构设计提供了实证依据。提出的异构宽度扩展思路将专家绑定从单纯的压缩技术，拓展为MoE深度-宽度权衡的新设计维度。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方案为Expert Tying（专家绑定）：将连续g层Transformer中所有MoE专家FFN的gate/up/down投影参数通过Python级指针别名实现跨层共享，仅需优化器正确处理绑定参数在多个使用位置的梯度累积，无需修改其他训练/推理基础设施；同时保留每层独立的路由、注意力投影与RMSNorm参数，确保隐藏状态仍经过g个不同的层算子变换。通过控制变量消融验证了该方案的可行性：每层独立的注意力是维持层间差异的核心（而非路由），因此共享参数量最大的专家FFN的质量代价极低，而共享注意力的质量损失会高出一个数量级。补充两个关键设计规则：1）模型首尾各2层不参与绑定（2+2的非绑定首尾段），该设计带来最大的单架构性能增益；2）异构宽度扩展：将专家绑定节省的参数重新投入到中间绑定层，增加专家数量，可在同参数量下稳定超过未绑定基线。此前的MoE跨层共享研究未开展跨架构、多粒度的控制变量分析，本工作的系统实验覆盖了这一缺口。
summary.experiments: 实验分为两阶段：1）小模型控制实验：采用32层解码器-only Transformer（d_model=512，8注意力头，序列长512，32专家top-8激活）验证组件共享代价；2）大规模预训练实验：覆盖OLMoE、Qwen3-MoE、DeepSeekMoE三种主流生产级MoE架构，最大参数量达7B。核心结果：当绑定组大小g=4时，总参数量最多降低52%，验证困惑度与下游任务精度几乎无退化，训练 wall-clock 速度最高提升23.7%。组件消融显示：解绑注意力带来的loss改善幅度比仅解绑路由高出一个数量级，验证了注意力是维持层差异的核心；异构宽度扩展方案在三种架构、同参数量设置下均超过未绑定基线；2+2非绑定首尾段的设计带来消融实验中最大的单架构性能增益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看Introduction部分对MoE显存开销与参数效率趋势矛盾的问题定义，再重点阅读Section 3的组件消融实验（核心结论：注意力是维持层差异的核心，专家FFN可安全共享，首尾层不宜绑定），以及Section 4的跨架构大规模预训练结果，尤其是异构宽度扩展的实验设计。预计阅读时间30-40分钟，重点关注组件消融的对比图表与跨架构性能对比表。

summary_en.core_problem: MoE architectures decouple total parameter count from per-token compute by activating only a small subset of expert FFNs per token, but require storing all expert parameters in memory during training and inference. For current open-source MoEs, only 3%-10% of parameters are active per token, so memory is dominated by idle parameters, creating a direct tension with recent parameter-efficiency trends (e.g., looped-depth models, OpenAI's Parameter Golf challenge) that maximize compute per unique parameter. Prior cross-layer parameter sharing work for MoEs lacks controlled, systematic analysis of the quality cost of sharing different components (expert FFNs, routers, attention, normalization), so no clear guidance exists for optimal sharing strategies.
summary_en.importance: Delivers a production-ready parameter efficiency optimization for MoEs that cuts memory footprint without meaningful quality loss, requiring no changes to existing training or inference infrastructure. Provides empirical evidence on the cost of sharing different MoE components across layers, informing future designs of parameter-efficient MoEs and looped-depth architectures. The proposed heterogeneous width expansion strategy reframes expert tying from a pure compression technique into a new design axis for MoE depth-width tradeoffs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Core method is Expert Tying: share gate/up/down projection weights of all MoE expert FFNs across a group of g consecutive Transformer layers via Python-level pointer aliasing. Only optimizer logic needs adjustment to correctly accumulate gradients from tied parameters across multiple use sites; no other training or inference infrastructure changes are required. Per-layer routers, attention projections, and RMSNorm parameters remain independent, so hidden states still pass through g distinct layer operators. Controlled component ablations confirm the feasibility of this design: per-layer attention (not routing) is the primary source of layer distinctiveness, so sharing the large expert FFN parameter pool incurs minimal quality cost, while sharing attention causes order-of-magnitude larger degradation. Two key design rules are validated: 1) leave the first 2 and last 2 layers untied (2+2 prelude/coda), which delivers the single largest architectural performance gain; 2) heterogeneous width expansion: reinvest parameters saved by tying into more experts in middle tied layers, which consistently outperforms untied baselines at iso-parameter count. Unlike prior MoE cross-layer sharing work that either ties full layer blocks or a single fixed component, this work provides controlled, cross-architecture, multi-granularity analysis of sharing costs.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are split into two stages: 1) Small-scale controlled experiments on a 32-layer decoder-only Transformer (d_model=512, 8 attention heads, sequence length 512, 32 experts with top-8 activation) to validate component sharing costs; 2) Large-scale pretraining across three production MoE architectures (OLMoE, Qwen3-MoE, DeepSeekMoE) with up to 7B total parameters. Key results: with group size g=4, total parameter count is reduced by up to 52%, with negligible degradation in validation perplexity and downstream task accuracy, and wall-clock training speed improved by up to 23.7%. Component ablations show untying attention improves loss by an order of magnitude more than untying routers alone, confirming attention as the core of layer distinctiveness. Heterogeneous width expansion outperforms untied baselines across all three architectures at matched parameter count. The 2+2 untied prelude/coda delivers the largest single architectural gain in ablation studies.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction first to grasp the core tension between MoE memory overhead and parameter-efficiency goals. Focus on Section 3's component ablations (the key finding that attention preserves layer distinctiveness, while expert FFNs can be shared safely, and first/last layers should remain untied) and Section 4's cross-architecture large-scale pretraining results, especially the heterogeneous width expansion experimental design. Expected reading time: 30-40 minutes; prioritize component ablation comparison charts and cross-architecture performance comparison tables.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得做内部复现：它在碰 MoE 一个很少被认真挑战的 prior——专家必须逐层独立；先看 tied depth 设计和 perplexity 曲线，再决定是否改自家 MoE 模板。
recommendation.en: This is worth an internal replication: it challenges a rarely questioned MoE prior—that experts must be layer-specific. Read the tied-depth design and perplexity curves before touching your MoE template.

paper.title: Different Layers, Different Manifolds: Module-Wise Weight-Space Geometry in Transformer Optimization
paper.abstract: Weight-space geometry plays a central role in neural network optimization, yet manifold constraints are often applied uniformly across all weight matrices. In this work, we ask whether different transformer modules prefer different manifold geometries. We study Manifold Muon for GPT-2 pretraining and compare layer-wise assignments of Stiefel and DGram constraints across attention and MLP blocks. Our results show a clear asymmetry: constraining attention layers with Stiefel geometry while assigni

summary.core_problem: Transformer预训练中不同模块(attention/MLP)是否应采用统一的权重空间流形约束，或模块差异化配置更优
summary.importance: 原理分析+方法启示——首次系统对比Stiefel/DGram约束在不同Transformer模块上的表现，发现模块不对称性，挑战统一流形约束的默认做法
summary.technical_approach: 在GPT-2预训练上实验Manifold Muon优化器，对比Stiefel(正交约束)和DGram(双Gram矩阵约束)在attention层与MLP层的分配；分析奇异值增长对attention logit和softmax饱和度的影响
summary.experiments: GPT-2预训练，Manifold Muon优化器；attention-Stiefel + MLP-DGram配置最优；反向配置和全DGram在共享超参下训练不稳定；DGram约束的attention权重出现奇异值增长、放大logit、softmax饱和
summary.authors_note: Kirato Yoshihara（独立作者，机构无法从摘要确认）

summary_en.core_problem: Whether different Transformer modules (attention/MLP) should use uniform weight-space manifold constraints during pretraining, or whether module-specific configurations are superior
summary_en.importance: Analysis + methodological insight—first systematic comparison of Stiefel/DGram constraints across Transformer modules, revealing module asymmetry and challenging the default uniform manifold constraint practice
summary_en.technical_approach: GPT-2 pretraining experiments with Manifold Muon optimizer, comparing inter-layer assignments of Stiefel (orthogonality) and DGram (double-Gram matrix) constraints between attention and MLP blocks; analyzes singular value growth impact on attention logits and softmax saturation
summary_en.experiments: GPT-2 pretraining, Manifold Muon optimizer; attention-Stiefel + MLP-DGram performs best; inverted and all-DGram assignments become unstable under shared hyperparameters; DGram-constrained attention weights exhibit singular value growth, amplified logits, and softmax saturation
summary_en.authors_note: Kirato Yoshihara (solo author, institution not identifiable from abstract)

recommendation.zh: 结论改变了流形约束应统一应用的默认认知——attention层必须保持Stiefel正交性，否则softmax会饱和。建议看§3几何分析和§4奇异值诊断
recommendation.en: Changes the default assumption that manifold constraints should be uniform—attention layers require Stiefel orthogonality to avoid softmax saturation. Recommend §3 geometry analysis and §4 singular value diagnostics

paper.title: TabCausal: Pretraining Across Causal Environments for Tabular Causal Discovery
paper.abstract: Causal discovery aims to recover directed causal relations from observational and interventional data, providing a basis for mechanistic understanding and reliable decision-making. Causal discovery foundation models (CDFMs) seek to amortize this problem by mapping a dataset directly to a causal graph in a single forward pass, avoiding per-dataset testing, search, or optimization. However, existing CDFMs remain limited, often failing to consistently match strong classical methods, and we find tha

summary.core_problem: 解决因预训练任务构造过窄而导致因果发现基础模型泛化差、难以稳定超过经典方法的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于非语言领域的“预训练任务设计”研究：它把 foundation model 思路用于表格因果发现，并强调任务分布设计比单一合成数据更关键。对 LLM 研究员的价值主要在于任务混合与环境多样性这个抽象层面的启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TabCausal：在多种因果环境上做广覆盖预训练，变化维度包括图先验、结构机制、噪声模型、变量维数、样本量和干预设定；再用动态任务构造策略，把这些环境组合成多样化 discovery tasks，让模型学习从 observational 和 mixed-interventional 数据直接映射到因果图。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在大规模合成与真实表格数据上评测，并与现有 causal discovery foundation models 及经典方法比较，结论是更稳定、更可迁移；但未给出模型规模、训练 token/样本量、具体提升幅度和关键 ablation 数字。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the poor generalization of causal discovery foundation models caused by overly narrow pretraining task construction.
summary_en.importance: This is a pretraining-task-design paper outside language modeling. It applies the foundation-model idea to tabular causal discovery and argues that task-distribution design matters more than a narrow synthetic setup. For LLM researchers, the value is mainly the abstract lesson on task mixture and environment diversity.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes TabCausal, which pretrains over a broad family of causal environments varying graph priors, structural mechanisms, noise models, dimensionality, sample sizes, and intervention regimes. A dynamic task-construction strategy composes these environments into diverse discovery tasks so the model can map observational and mixed-interventional data directly to causal graphs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims results on large-scale synthetic and real tabular datasets against prior causal discovery foundation models and classical baselines, with better robustness and transfer. It does not provide model size, training scale, exact gains, or key ablation numbers.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但“预训练分布比模型头部更决定泛化”这个判断值得借鉴；看任务构造部分即可，别把结果外推太远。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but the lesson that pretraining distribution matters more than the model head is worth borrowing; read the task-construction part and avoid overgeneralizing.

paper.title: Parallax: Parameterized Local Linear Attention for Language Modeling
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become the central paradigm in artificial intelligence, yet the core computational primitive of attention has remained structurally unchanged. Local Linear Attention (LLA) is an attention mechanism derived from nonparametric statistics in the test-time regression framework. In contrast to prior research on efficient attention variants, LLA upgrades the local constant estimate in softmax attention to a local linear estimate, yielding provably superior bias-varian

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是一个很具体的注意力替代问题：Local Linear Attention 在理论上比 softmax attention 的局部常数估计更强，但原始 LLA 需要逐 token 做共轭梯度求解，计算、I/O 和数值稳定性都不适合大规模语言模型预训练。Parallax 试图保留 LLA 的局部线性估计思想，同时把它改写成可训练、可部署、可做预训练规模验证的注意力层。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有两点。第一，它不是单纯追求线性复杂度，而是把 attention 看成 test-time regression solver，讨论 softmax、linear attention、LLA 之间的估计偏差、方差和记忆容量取舍。这比“替换 softmax 降低复杂度”的叙事更接近语言模型能力差异的核心。第二，论文强调 optimizer-architecture interaction：Parallax 的 correction branch 在 AdamW 下优势不明显，但在 Muon 下表现出稳定收益。这提示一些新结构可能不是结构本身无效，而是被优化器几何限制住了。对基座预训练来说，这类结论比单个 attention 变体的增益更有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Parallax 从 LLA 出发。LLA 把 KV cache 视为局部回归数据，用局部线性估计替代 softmax attention 类似的局部常数估计，因此理论上可以表达更丰富的 query-conditioned prediction。但原始 LLA 需要在每个位置解一个局部加权线性问题，难以在长上下文和大 batch 下高效实现。Parallax 的做法是引入额外的 R 矩阵，与标准 Q、K、V 一起工作，让模型用参数化方式探测 KV 协方差信息，形成一个可学习的 correction branch。这样避免了逐 token 的非参数求解，同时保留“根据局部二阶结构修正 attention 输出”的思路。论文还给出硬件感知的 streaming algorithm 和自定义 decode kernel，目标是在不牺牲可实现性的前提下逼近 LLA 的表达优势。与 DeltaNet、Mamba 等常数状态模型相比，Parallax 更接近 softmax attention 的上下文访问模式；与 FlashAttention 相比，它改变的是注意力机制，而不是只优化 softmax attention 的实现。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 synthetic tasks 和语言模型预训练。论文报告在 0.6B 与 1.7B 模型规模上，Parallax 相比 softmax attention 在 perplexity 和下游准确率上都有稳定提升，并且在参数量匹配和计算量匹配设置下仍然成立。效率方面，自定义 decode kernel 在不同 batch size 和 context length 下可以达到或超过 FlashAttention 2/3 的解码性能。一个关键实验结论是优化器依赖：使用 Muon 时 Parallax 相比 softmax attention 有更明显优势；使用 AdamW 时两者接近。这说明 correction branch 对矩阵参数更新的几何性质敏感，Muon 的正交化/矩阵几何更新可能更适合训练这类协方差探测结构。文中给出的具体收益幅度需要重点查看预训练结果表、compute-matched 对照表和 optimizer ablation。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 30–45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 LLA scaling 难点和 Parallax 设计动机的描述，再看方法部分中 R 矩阵、correction branch 和 streaming algorithm 的推导。实验部分重点看三类表/图：0.6B 与 1.7B 预训练 PPL 和 downstream 结果，parameter-matched 与 compute-matched 控制实验，AdamW/Muon 的优化器消融。真正值得细读的是 optimizer-architecture interaction：如果只把这篇论文当作一个新 attention kernel，会漏掉它对预训练 recipe 的提示。需要谨慎的是，1.7B 仍属于中等规模验证，是否能外推到更大模型、MoE、长上下文退火阶段，还要看更大规模实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a narrow but important gap: Local Linear Attention has a stronger statistical interpretation than softmax attention, but the original formulation is not practical for large-scale LM pretraining because it requires a per-token conjugate-gradient solve with high compute, I/O cost, and numerical sensitivity. Parallax keeps the local linear estimation principle while turning it into a trainable and scalable attention layer.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is not just that Parallax is another efficient attention variant. The paper frames attention mechanisms as test-time regression solvers and studies the bias-variance and memory-capacity tradeoff between softmax attention, linear attention, and LLA. It also reports a strong optimizer-architecture interaction: the proposed correction branch shows clear gains under Muon, while the advantage is much weaker under AdamW. This is a useful reminder that some architectural ideas may fail under the default optimizer geometry rather than because the mechanism itself is weak.
summary_en.technical_approach: Parallax starts from LLA, where the KV cache is treated as local regression data and the model predicts the value for a query using a local linear estimator instead of the local constant estimator implicit in softmax-style attention. The obstacle is that exact LLA requires solving a local weighted linear problem at every position. Parallax replaces this nonparametric solve with a parameterized mechanism: it adds an R matrix alongside Q, K, and V, and uses it to probe the covariance structure of the KV set through a learned correction branch. The design aims to preserve the benefit of local second-order structure without paying the cost of per-token optimization. The paper also develops a hardware-aware streaming algorithm and a custom decode kernel. Compared with constant-state linear attention or SSMs, Parallax retains a more attention-like access pattern; compared with FlashAttention, it changes the modeling mechanism rather than only the implementation of softmax attention.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports results on synthetic tasks and LM pretraining at 0.6B and 1.7B scale. Parallax consistently improves perplexity and downstream accuracy over softmax attention, and the gains remain under both parameter-matched and compute-matched controls. On the systems side, the custom decode kernel matches or outperforms FlashAttention 2/3 across a range of batch sizes and context lengths. The most informative ablation is the optimizer comparison: Parallax obtains substantial gains with Muon, while AdamW makes Parallax and softmax attention much closer. This suggests that the covariance-probing correction branch depends on the geometry of matrix updates.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30–45 minutes. Read the motivation for why exact LLA does not scale, then inspect the method section for the R matrix, the correction branch, and the streaming implementation. In the experiments, focus on the 0.6B/1.7B pretraining tables, the parameter-matched and compute-matched controls, and the AdamW-versus-Muon ablation. The optimizer interaction is the main point to retain. The current evidence is still at moderate model scale, so the open question is whether the same behavior holds for larger dense models, MoE models, and long-context pretraining or annealing runs.

recommendation.zh: 注意力机制的重要进展：局部线性估计从非参数统计角度改进了softmax的偏差-方差权衡，做注意力变体研究的应细读§3的参数化设计。
recommendation.en: A notable advance in attention mechanisms: local linear estimation improves softmax's bias-variance tradeoff from a nonparametric statistics perspective; read §3's parameterization design carefully if working on attention variants.

paper.title: Latent Recurrent Transformer: Architecture Exploration, Training Strategies, and Scaling Behavior
paper.abstract: We study Latent Recurrent Transformer (LRT), a lightweight augmentation of autoregressive transformers that reuses a high-level source-layer hidden state from the previous token as recurrent memory for the next token. Because this source state is already computed during ordinary decoding, LRT adds a cross-layer recurrent latent pathway across positions without inserting pause tokens or extra depth loops, and the standard attention mechanism and KV-cache interface are preserved. To pretrain this

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是一个架构与训练耦合问题：如何给自回归 Transformer 加入 token 级递归计算，让当前位置能复用前一位置的高层隐藏状态，同时不增加思考 token、不做额外深度循环，也不破坏标准 KV-cache 推理接口。
summary.importance: 这篇工作值得精读，因为它把“增加测试时计算”和“保持预训练并行性”之间的矛盾处理得比较克制。很多递归或 latent reasoning 方法通过额外 token、重复 block 或分段记忆实现更多计算，但推理成本和训练形式都会改变。LRT 的选择更贴近现有 LLM 训练栈：只增加一条跨位置、跨层的 latent memory pathway，默认变体参数增加约 0.3%，解码仍是一 token 一次正常 forward，KV-cache 形状不变。对预训练研究的影响在于，它给出了一种低侵入式递归架构，并配套提出可并行训练的近似方案。这个组合比单纯提出 recurrence 更关键。
summary.technical_approach: LRT 选择某个源层 l_src，将位置 t 的隐藏状态 h_t^{l_src} 作为 recurrent memory m_t。生成位置 t 时，模型使用标准 causal attention 和 KV cache，同时把 m_{t-1} 注入当前 token 的计算。这样，当前位置的早期或中间层可以直接访问前一 token 的高层表示，而标准 Transformer 在 KV-cache 解码时，层 l 只能访问过去 token 同一层的缓存。论文研究了两类注入方式。KV Projection 把 memory 通过 attention 的 key-value 路径注入，使注意力计算能看到这条递归信息；Residual Injection 则把 memory 作为残差式信号注入层表示。默认方案把两者结合，并使用共享投影来控制参数量。训练难点在于，真实推理时存在 m_1 到 m_T 的顺序递归链，直接按 token 展开会失去 Transformer 预训练的并行优势。为此论文提出 interleaved parallel training：先用一次全序列初始化 forward 建立 memory buffer；然后把位置划分为若干互不重叠的交错子集，每个子集内部并行 refinement，并把更新后的状态写回 buffer；后续子集可以读取前面子集更新过的 memory。它不是精确 unroll，而是在固定训练预算下让每个 token 至少经历一次带递归记忆的 refinement，比 chunked recurrence 只在块边界传递 memory 更接近 token-level recurrence。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 baseline-equivalent training compute，对比标准 Transformer 和 LRT 在不同模型规模、不同 tokens-per-parameter 预算下的 scaling behavior。主要指标包括 BPB，以及 Li et al. 2024 使用的 CORE。结果显示，LRT 的 scaling curve 向更低 BPB 和更高 CORE 移动，说明同等训练计算下质量更好。默认 shared-projection 变体只增加约 0.3% 参数。消融实验给出几个有用结论：KV Projection 和 Residual Injection 是互补的，组合优于单独使用；源层不是越靠后越好，上中层作为 recurrent memory 往往强于最终层，说明最终层可能过度贴近 logits 预测，而不一定是最适合作为下一 token 早期计算输入的通用状态；interleaved parallel training 比简单 chunked 训练更贴近推理时的 token-level recurrence。正文片段没有给出完整规模表和具体 BPB/CORE 数字，精读时应核对每个规模的 compute matching、训练 token 数、参数增量，以及 inference latency 是否只增加投影和注入开销。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 architecture 部分，重点是 m_t = h_t^{l_src} 的定义、memory 注入到哪些层、KV Projection 与 Residual Injection 的具体公式，以及为什么这条路径是标准 causal attention 没有的跨层信息通道。然后看 interleaved parallel training，特别是初始化 forward、交错子集划分、buffer 写回顺序，以及它和真实 sequential recurrence 的偏差。实验部分优先看 scaling curves，而不是只看单点 benchmark；再看源层选择、注入方式、共享/非共享投影、训练策略的消融。值得深挖的问题有三个：第一，训练时的 interleaved 近似和推理时严格递归之间是否存在分布偏移；第二，memory 只取 t-1 是否足够，还是需要更长 latent state；第三，这条高层状态反馈是否会改变深层表示的 specialization，进而影响长上下文和推理任务。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to add token-level recurrence to an autoregressive Transformer by reusing a high-level hidden state from the previous position, while preserving one-forward-pass decoding, standard causal attention, and the existing KV-cache interface.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong pretraining-architecture paper because it treats recurrence as a systems-compatible modeling change rather than as an add-on that requires extra thinking tokens or repeated block applications. Many recurrent or latent-computation methods increase inference cost by adding depth loops or additional decoding steps. LRT instead introduces a cross-position, cross-layer latent pathway with about 0.3% extra parameters in the default shared-projection variant. The more important contribution is the pairing of this architecture with a parallel training approximation, since exact token-by-token recurrence would remove the main efficiency advantage of Transformer pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: LRT selects a source layer l_src and defines the recurrent memory at position t as m_t = h_t^{l_src}. When processing position t, the model uses the usual causal attention and KV cache, and additionally injects m_{t-1} into the current-token computation. This creates a pathway that standard KV-cached Transformers do not have: layer l at the current position normally attends only to past states from the same layer, while LRT allows early or middle computation at the current position to access a high-level representation already computed for the previous token. The paper studies two lightweight injection mechanisms. KV Projection routes the memory through the attention key-value pathway. Residual Injection adds it as a residual signal to layer representations. The default model combines both and uses shared projections to keep parameter growth small. For training, the paper introduces interleaved parallel training. A full-sequence initialization forward first builds a shared memory buffer. Then disjoint interleaved position subsets are refined in parallel and written back to the buffer. Later subsets can consume memories updated by earlier subsets. This does not exactly reproduce sequential recurrence, but it gives every token a recurrent-memory-aware refinement step under a fixed training budget and is closer to token-level recurrence than chunked memory propagation.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare LRT with matched-depth Transformer baselines under baseline-equivalent training compute, across model sizes and tokens-per-parameter budgets. The main reported outcomes are lower BPB and higher CORE, shifting the scaling curves in favor of LRT. The default shared-projection variant adds only about 0.3% parameters. Ablations indicate that KV Projection and Residual Injection are complementary, that an upper-middle source layer can outperform the final layer as recurrent memory, and that the training approximation matters. The source-layer result is especially informative: the final layer may be too specialized for next-token logits, while an upper-middle layer provides a more reusable latent state for the next position. The provided text does not include the complete numeric tables, so the key checks are compute matching, exact model sizes, token budgets, BPB/CORE deltas, and the measured inference overhead beyond the unchanged KV-cache shape.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it closely. Start with the architecture section and verify the definition of m_t, the target layers that receive memory, and the formulas for KV Projection and Residual Injection. Then study interleaved parallel training: the initialization pass, subset schedule, buffer update order, and the gap between this approximation and true sequential recurrence. In the experiments, prioritize scaling curves over isolated benchmark numbers, then inspect ablations for source-layer choice, injection type, shared versus unshared projections, and training strategy. The most useful follow-up questions are whether the training approximation creates inference-time mismatch, whether memory from only t-1 is enough, and whether feeding upper-layer states back into earlier computation changes representation specialization in long-context or reasoning-heavy settings.

recommendation.zh: 值得立刻看训练算法和 ablation；若 2x compute 下 loss/ICL 曲线干净，LRT 会改变 latent compute 只能靠 pause token 的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Read the training algorithm and ablations first; if the 2x-compute loss and ICL curves are clean, LRT weakens the default assumption that latent compute must be implemented with pause tokens.

paper.title: TSFMAudit: Data Contamination Auditing in Forecasting Time Series Foundation Models
paper.abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are increasingly pretrained on large corpora, raising concerns that evaluation datasets may have been exposed during pretraining and thus yield overly optimistic performance estimates. Auditing such contamination is challenging in time series because signals are continuous and heterogeneous, and often lack corpus documentation. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to study pretraining contamination auditing for TSFMs. We formalize the problem

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是时间序列 foundation model 的预训练污染审计。具体说，不是问某个样本是否被记住，而是问一个评测数据集是否在预训练语料中以原始、缩放、重命名、重窗口化等形式出现过。时间序列和文本不同，连续值、异构频率、预处理变体很多，简单的字符串重合、近重复检索、静态 loss 阈值或标准 membership inference 都不太可靠。论文要解决的是：在拿不到完整预训练语料文档、也不可能重训大量 shadow model 的现实条件下，如何对 TSFM 的 benchmark contamination 做可操作的审计。
summary.importance: 它不属于 LLM 基座主线，但和预训练研究里的 contamination auditing、benchmark validity、membership inference 有明显方法学关联。启发点主要有两层。第一，论文把“静态低 loss 不等于污染”讲得很清楚：时间序列里平滑、强周期、低熵数据即使没见过，也可能天然容易预测，因此单看 perplexity 风格指标会误报。第二，它把审计信号从静态拟合优度转到 probe adaptation dynamics，也就是看模型在小规模微调探针下的学习速度和参数位移。这种思路对其他模态的预训练污染检测也有借鉴意义，尤其是在内容重合难定义、语料谱系不透明的场景里。贡献量级偏方法型和评测型，不是基础范式变化。
summary.technical_approach:
TSFMAudit 的核心假设是：如果某个审计数据集在预训练中被见过或高度近似见过，那么模型在这个数据集上的少量 probe fine-tuning 会表现出异常高效的适应动态。这里的“高效”不是只指初始 loss 低，而是指在很少更新步数下 loss 降得更快，同时 backbone 参数移动更小。直觉上，污染数据离模型已有表示更近，因此只需要轻微调整就能对齐到更低误差。

基于这个观察，方法流程大致分三步。第一，对候选 TSFM 和待审计数据集做一个受控的 probe fine-tuning，训练预算很小，目的是激发可比较的适应动态，而不是把任务真正训好。第二，从这个短程适应过程中提取动态特征，包括 loss reduction、参数 displacement，以及文中提到的其他 probe-time signals。第三，用这些特征构造 contamination risk score，判断该数据集是否可能出现在预训练语料中。

论文的一个重要设计是把审计目标定义在 dataset level，而不是单样本 level。原因很现实：时间序列 benchmark 往往由同一底层 source series 经过窗口切分、缩放、重采样得到多个样本，单样本判断既不稳定，也不符合实际 benchmark 污染的关切。作者因此先形式化了“样本来自某个底层 source time series，而该 source 是否在预训练语料中出现过”的定义，再把污染程度写成 dataset-level contamination ratio。

和 LLM 文献里的几类基线相比，TSFMAudit 刻意避开了两个难点。它不依赖显式 overlap detection，因为时间序列的近重复常常不是字面重复；也不依赖 shadow model 大规模校准 membership score，因为重训 TSFM 成本太高。它选择 probe dynamics，是因为这类信号同时利用了模型已有记忆和局部可塑性，能比静态 loss 更好地区分“天然容易预测”和“曾经见过”。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 6 个 TSFM，使用各模型公开报告的预训练语料信息，并在 GIFT-Eval 和 TIME benchmark 上做审计，总计 187 个数据集。比较对象包括从 LLM 污染检测文献改造来的 10 个基线。论文给出的主结论是：TSFMAudit 在不同模型和 benchmark 上都更稳定，检测性能 consistently stronger。

从引言和方法描述能看出的关键实验点有几项。第一，作者展示了污染数据集在 probe fine-tuning 下通常有更快的 loss reduction 和更小的 backbone movement，这个现象既是方法动机，也是后续特征设计的依据。第二，特征消融表明 adaptation dynamics 确实比单纯静态 loss 更有判别力，尤其参数位移这类“模型为了适应数据需要动多少”的信号是有增益的。第三，论文强调其方法适用于多种 TSFM，而不是绑定某个特定架构。

给出的全文片段没有完整结果表和具体 AUC / F1 数字，因此不宜编造精确分数。但实验规模、比较设置和结论方向是明确的：作者不是做个案分析，而是在较大范围 benchmark 上验证 probe dynamics 作为 contamination signal 的有效性。
summary.reading_guide:
如果你主要关心预训练污染审计的方法迁移，先看 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation。这里把为什么 LLM 里的 overlap / perplexity / membership inference 不能直接搬到时间序列讲得比较透，也把 dataset-level contamination 的定义立住了。

然后看方法部分里 probe fine-tuning 的设置、提取了哪些动态特征、最终如何组合成风险分数。这里最值得想的是：哪些特征反映“记忆”，哪些特征反映“可塑性”，以及两者为什么能区分污染与天然易预测数据。

实验部分优先看 feature ablation 和跨模型泛化结果。若只做泛读，30 分钟左右足够；若你做 benchmark hygiene、membership inference 或多模态 foundation model 审计，建议把附录里的实现细节和数据构造也看一下。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies pretraining contamination auditing for time-series foundation models. The question is not whether a single sample was memorized, but whether an evaluation dataset may have appeared in pretraining, possibly under rescaling, renaming, rewindowing, or other preprocessing changes. This is harder than in text because time series are continuous, heterogeneous, and often poorly documented at the corpus level. Straightforward overlap checks, static loss thresholds, or standard membership inference do not transfer cleanly. The paper asks how to build a practical contamination auditor without full corpus provenance and without retraining many shadow models.
summary_en.importance: This is outside core LLM pretraining, but it is methodologically relevant to contamination auditing, benchmark validity, and membership inference. The main lesson is that low static loss is not enough evidence of contamination in time series: smooth or strongly seasonal series can be easy to predict even when unseen. The paper therefore shifts the signal from static fit quality to probe-time adaptation dynamics. That idea may transfer to other modalities where exact overlap is ill-defined and corpus lineage is opaque. The contribution is mainly methodological and evaluative rather than a change in foundation-model training itself.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TSFMAudit is built on a simple hypothesis: if an audited dataset was seen, or nearly seen, during pretraining, then a short probe fine-tuning run on that dataset should look unusually efficient. Efficiency here is not just low initial loss. It means faster loss reduction under a small update budget and smaller movement of the backbone parameters. Intuitively, contaminated data are already close to the model’s internal representation, so only limited adjustment is needed to fit them well.

The procedure has three stages. First, the candidate TSFM is subjected to a controlled probe fine-tuning run on the audited dataset, with a deliberately small training budget. The goal is not to optimize forecasting performance, but to expose comparable adaptation dynamics. Second, the method extracts probe-time signals such as loss reduction and parameter displacement, along with related dynamic features described in the paper. Third, these features are combined into a contamination-risk score for the model–dataset pair.

A notable design choice is that the audit target is defined at the dataset level rather than the sample level. This matches the practical structure of forecasting benchmarks, where many samples are windows derived from the same underlying source series. The paper formalizes contamination in terms of whether the source time series behind an audited sample appears in the pretraining corpus, and then defines a dataset-level contamination ratio.

Relative to LLM-style baselines, the method deliberately avoids two difficult dependencies. It does not rely on explicit overlap detection, because near-duplicates in time series are often transformed rather than literally repeated. It also avoids large-scale shadow-model calibration, which would be expensive for TSFMs. Probe dynamics are used because they capture both prior familiarity and local plasticity, making them better suited than static loss to distinguish contamination from inherently easy-to-forecast data.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers 6 TSFMs and uses their reported pretraining-corpus information together with GIFT-Eval and the TIME benchmark, for a total of 187 datasets. The comparison includes 10 baselines adapted from the LLM contamination-auditing literature. The main result is that TSFMAudit delivers consistently stronger detection performance across models and benchmarks.

Several experimental points matter. First, the paper shows that contaminated datasets tend to exhibit faster loss reduction and smaller backbone movement during probe fine-tuning. This observation is both the empirical motivation and the basis for feature design. Second, the feature ablations indicate that adaptation dynamics carry more discriminative signal than static loss alone, and parameter-displacement features appear to add useful information beyond fit quality. Third, the method is evaluated across multiple TSFMs rather than being tied to one architecture.

The provided excerpt does not include the full result tables or exact AUC/F1 values, so it would be unsafe to fabricate precise numbers. Still, the experimental scope and conclusion are clear: the paper validates probe-time dynamics as a practical contamination signal at benchmark scale rather than through isolated case studies.
summary_en.reading_guide:
If your main interest is contamination auditing methodology, start with the Introduction and Problem Formulation. Those sections explain clearly why overlap checks, perplexity-style tests, and standard membership inference from the LLM literature do not directly transfer to time series, and they establish the dataset-level contamination objective.

Then read the method section with attention to the probe fine-tuning setup, the dynamic features that are extracted, and how they are combined into a risk score. The most useful question to keep in mind is which features reflect prior memory and which reflect plasticity, and why that combination separates contamination from naturally easy data.

In the experiments, prioritize the feature ablations and the cross-model results. A solid skim should take around 30 minutes. If you work on benchmark hygiene, membership inference, or auditing for multimodal foundation models, the implementation details and dataset construction in the appendix are worth a closer look.

recommendation.zh: 数据污染是预训练的核心关切，TSFMAudit的探针适应动力学思路可迁移至LLM污染检测，看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: Data contamination is a core pretraining concern; TSFMAudit's probe adaptation dynamics approach is transferable to LLM contamination detection—read the method section.

paper.title: Tokenization with Split Trees
paper.abstract: We introduce Tokenization with Split Trees (ToaST), a subword tokenization method that directly optimizes compression under a new recursive inference procedure. ToaST greedily splits each pretoken into a full binary tree using precomputed byte n-gram counts, independent of any vocabulary. Given a vocabulary, inference recursively descends each split tree and emits the first in-vocabulary node reached on each path.
