summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是子词 tokenizer 训练中的一个老问题：BPE 用贪心 merge 近似压缩目标，但它并没有直接优化最终词表在推理时产生的 token 数；如果改用全局最优的 shortest-path inference，词表选择又会遇到 NP-hard 的组合优化问题。ToaST 的核心思路是换一个推理结构：先用与词表无关的 split tree 固定所有候选切分，再在这棵树上做词表选择。这样把 tokenizer 训练从“学习 merge 规则”改成“在固定候选结构里选节点”，目标仍然是压缩，但优化问题更可控。
summary.importance: 这篇对预训练研究的价值主要在 tokenizer 设计。它给出了一种与 BPE、UnigramLM、SaGe 都不同的训练/推理分解：切分结构先由字节 n-gram 统计决定，词表再通过优化选出。这个分解有两个实际影响。第一，词表变化不会改变候选切分结构，因此可以更干净地研究 vocab size、压缩率、单个 token 删除/加入对分词的影响。第二，训练目标直接对应总 token 数，能更明确地服务于训练和推理成本、有效上下文长度。贡献量级不只是一个小的 tokenizer heuristic；它把“压缩最优 tokenizer”这个难题改写成一个在实践中 LP relaxation 近似整数的优化问题。不过下游语言模型结果仍偏早期，只在 1.5B Nanochat 设置上验证，不能直接推出所有规模和多语种场景的收益。
summary.technical_approach: ToaST 分两步。第一步构造 split tree。训练语料先用正则切成 pretokens，然后统计 pretoken 内的 byte n-gram 计数。对每个 pretoken，从完整字符串开始递归二分：枚举所有可能的左右切分，选择使 min(count(left), count(right)) 最大的切分；如果候选不在计数字典中，则退化为取最长已知前缀。这个准则倾向于让两边都是常见片段，避免生成一边很常见、一边很碎的切分。递归直到叶子是单字节，得到一棵完整二叉树。第二步是在所有树节点中选词表。给定一个词表，推理时从根节点开始，如果当前节点在词表中就直接输出；否则递归访问左右孩子。这样每个输出 token 一定是 split tree 的某个节点，所有必要的 UTF-8 单字节都强制在词表中以避免 unknown token。训练时把词表选择写成整数规划，目标是在固定词表大小下最小化训练语料总 token 数。LP relaxation 在实验中几乎是整数解，目标值距离全局最优可到 1e-6 量级。与 BPE 相比，ToaST 不依赖 merge 顺序；与 shortest-path tokenizer 相比，它不在所有 substring 上做最短路推理，而是在预先固定的 tree 结构上递归推理，因此牺牲一部分候选自由度，换来更容易优化的全局词表选择。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了最多 700,000 棵 split trees 的训练规模，覆盖训练数据聚合 pretoken counts 的 99%，训练时间经验上随 split tree 数量近似二次增长。压缩实验显示，在英语文本上，当词表大小为 40,960 或更大时，ToaST 相比多个标准 tokenizer baseline 至少减少 11% token 数，Rényi efficiency 也有相近幅度提升。语言模型实验使用 Nanochat，模型深度 24、参数量 1.5B。ToaST 在 CORE metric 上取得最高结果，并且显著优于三个 baseline 中的两个。这个结果说明更强压缩没有明显损害小规模 LM 训练，甚至可能通过更长的有效上下文和更低 token 成本带来收益。需要注意的是，论文给出的 LM 验证还不是 scaling law 级别实验；参数量、语种、训练 token budget、post-training 设置都还不足以支持普遍结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 split tree 构造、split tree inference 和词表选择的整数规划部分。重点看三个问题：一是 split 准则为什么用 min(count(left), count(right))，它如何影响树的形状和候选 token 分布；二是推理过程为什么能让任意包含必要字节的词表都合法，这一点是它区别于 BPE merge rules 的关键；三是 IP/LP relaxation 的变量定义和约束，尤其是“某节点被选入词表”和“某节点在推理中被输出”之间的关系。实验部分建议重点看压缩率随 vocab size 的曲线、LP near-integrality 的统计、700k split trees 的扩展性结果、Nanochat 1.5B 的 CORE 指标。附录里的 inference speed 和多字节字符处理也值得看，因为 tokenizer 如果推理慢，压缩收益会被工程开销抵消。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a concrete tokenizer training problem: BPE is a greedy compression heuristic, while directly selecting a vocabulary for globally optimal shortest-path tokenization is computationally hard. ToaST changes the inference structure. It first builds vocabulary-independent binary split trees for pretokens, then chooses a fixed-size vocabulary from the tree nodes to minimize the final token count under recursive tree inference.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly relevant to tokenizer design for pretraining. It gives a clean separation between candidate segmentation and vocabulary selection. Once split trees are built, changing the vocabulary does not change the candidate structure, which makes vocabulary-size studies and token ablations easier to reason about. The objective is also directly tied to total token count, so the method targets training cost, inference cost, and effective context length more directly than merge-based BPE. The language-model evidence is still limited to a 1.5B Nanochat setting, so the downstream claim should be read as promising but not yet a scaling result.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToaST first pretokenizes the corpus and aggregates unique pretokens by count. It then uses byte n-gram counts inside pretoken boundaries to recursively split each pretoken into a full binary tree. For each candidate split, it scores the split by the smaller count of the left and right substrings, choosing the split with the largest minimum count. This favors balanced, frequent components rather than lopsided decompositions. Given a vocabulary, inference starts at the root of the tree. If the current node is in the vocabulary, it is emitted as a token; otherwise inference recurses on the two children. All required UTF-8 single-byte tokens are included to avoid unknown tokens. Vocabulary training is formulated as an integer program over tree nodes, with the objective of minimizing the total number of emitted training tokens under a fixed vocabulary size. Its LP relaxation is nearly integral in practice, which gives near-optimal vocabularies without relying on BPE-style merge order.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports computations up to 700,000 split trees, covering 99% of the aggregated pretoken counts in the training data. Empirical training time scales roughly quadratically with the number of split trees. On English text, ToaST reduces token count by at least 11% for vocabulary sizes of 40,960 and above compared with standard tokenizer baselines, with comparable gains in Rényi efficiency. In a Nanochat language-model experiment with a 24-layer, 1.5B-parameter model, ToaST obtains the best CORE metric and clearly outperforms two of the three baselines. The result is useful because it shows that stronger compression does not simply degrade LM quality in this setting, but the experiment is not broad enough to settle behavior at larger model scales or in multilingual training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the split-tree construction, recursive inference, and IP/LP vocabulary-selection sections carefully. The main technical details are the split scoring rule, the legality of arbitrary vocabularies under tree inference, and the optimization variables that connect selected vocabulary nodes to emitted tokens. In the experiments, focus on compression versus vocabulary size, near-integrality of the LP relaxation, scaling to 700k split trees, and the 1.5B Nanochat LM results. The appendix material on inference speed and UTF-8 byte handling is also useful for judging whether the compression gain can survive tokenizer engineering costs.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该认真看：如果 token 数真能稳定降 10%+，它会直接改你的 tokenizer prior；先盯住推理规则和 IP/LP 松弛是否在大语料上还能站住。
recommendation.en: This one deserves real attention: if the 10%+ token reduction is robust, it changes tokenizer priors immediately; focus on the inference rule and whether the IP/LP story survives at scale.

paper.title: Compute Optimal Tokenization
paper.abstract: Scaling laws enable the optimal selection of data amount and language model size, yet the impact of the data unit, the token, on this relationship remains underexplored. In this work, we systematically investigate how the information granularity of tokens, controlled by the compression rate (i.e., average bytes of text per token), affects scaling trends. We train 988 latent tokenized models (BLT) ranging from 50M to 7B parameters that enable setting the desired compression rate. This flexibility

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 scaling law 里一个长期被简化的问题：训练数据到底应该按 token 计量，还是按底层文本信息量计量。传统 Chinchilla 式结论把最优数据量写成 tokens per parameter，但 token 不是稳定单位。不同 tokenizer 的压缩率不同，同样一段文本可以被表示成更多或更少 token。论文把压缩率定义为平均每个 token 覆盖的字节数，并系统研究压缩率如何改变最优模型规模、最优数据量和固定算力下的 loss。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响很直接：如果结论成立，compute-optimal 配比不应简单写成固定的 token/parameter，而应写成更接近 byte/parameter 的关系。也就是说，换 tokenizer 或提高压缩率后，不能机械沿用“每参数 20 个 token”这类经验规则。更高压缩率会减少序列长度，释放训练 FLOPs，但也会让每个 token 承载更多信息，增加建模难度。论文的贡献不是提出一个新 tokenizer，而是把 tokenization 纳入 scaling law 的自变量，使 tokenizer 选择从经验工程问题变成可估计的算力分配问题。
summary.technical_approach: 论文使用 Byte Latent Transformer 作为主要实验工具，因为 BLT 可以在不改变词表大小的情况下控制压缩率。模型把字节序列先由局部 encoder 聚合成 latent tokens，再由全局 Transformer 在 latent token 上建模，最后由 decoder 回到字节级做 next-byte prediction。这样可以把“压缩率”从“词表设计”里解耦出来，避免 BPE 这类方法里词表大小、token 边界、参数量和压缩率同时变化。作者还去掉了原 BLT 中的 byte n-gram hash embeddings，因为 n-gram 可能跨越多个 latent token，会干扰对目标压缩率的控制。局部 encoder/decoder 的 scaling recipe 也做了调整，偏向增加宽度而不是深度，以降低局部模块成为瓶颈的风险。核心建模思路是拟合带压缩率变量的 scaling law：数据规模既可按 token 数表示，也可按 byte 数表示；训练算力则由模型大小、token 数和 BLT 局部模块开销共同决定。随后作者用 subword tokenizer 模型做外部验证，检查 BLT 上观察到的规律是否只是 latent tokenization 的架构效应。多语言实验进一步用 parity，即平行句在不同语言中的 byte 长度比，解释不同语言下最优数据配比和压缩率的变化。
summary.experiments: 主要实验规模较大：作者训练了 988 个 BLT 模型，参数量覆盖 50M 到 7B，并在一系列目标压缩率下拟合 scaling trends。文中明确对比了常见 BPE 在英文 DCLM 风格语料上的压缩率约 4.57 bytes/token，以及 SuperBPE 约 6.16 bytes/token；BLT 的实验范围覆盖并超过这些压缩率。关键结论是，在 compute-optimal 配置下，最优模型参数量与数据的 byte 数更接近成比例关系，而不是与 token 数成比例关系。等价地说，当压缩率升高时，最优 token/parameter 会下降；保持固定 token/parameter 会导致实际喂入的 byte 数随压缩率变化，从而偏离最优算力分配。实验还显示压缩率不是越高越好。提高压缩率减少了全局 Transformer 处理的 token 数，但每个 latent token 需要承载更多局部信息，局部 encoder/decoder 的负担和预测难度会上升，因此存在固定算力下的较优压缩区间。subword-tokenized 模型实验用于验证趋势是否可迁移到常规 tokenizer；多语言实验则表明，语言的 byte parity 会影响最优配比，byte 长度更高的语言不能直接套用英文 token 规则。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 中对四个研究问题的定义，它把论文从“比较 tokenizer”提升到了“重写 scaling law 单位”的层面。Methodology 里要重点看 BLT 的改动、局部模块 scaling recipe、压缩率控制方式，以及为什么去掉 hash n-gram embeddings。实验部分建议优先看三个图表：一是不同压缩率下 loss 随模型大小和数据量的 scaling 曲线；二是 compute-optimal frontier 上参数量、token 数、byte 数的关系；三是最优压缩率随算力预算变化的曲线。subword tokenizer 部分适合检查外推性，尤其要看 BPE、SuperBPE 与 BLT 的趋势是否一致。多语言部分建议关注 parity 的定义和实证关系，它对多语预训练的数据配比有直接参考价值。值得深挖的问题有两个：第一，BLT 局部模块开销如何进入算力估计；第二，byte-level loss 与常规 token-level perplexity 如何公平比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a basic but often hidden assumption in language-model scaling laws: whether training data should be measured in tokens or in a tokenizer-independent unit of information. The usual Chinchilla-style rule expresses the optimal data-to-parameter ratio in tokens per parameter, but a token is not a stable unit. The same text can become many short tokens or fewer compressed tokens depending on the tokenizer. The paper treats compression rate, defined as average bytes per token, as an explicit scaling variable and studies how it changes compute-optimal model size, data size, and loss.
summary_en.importance: The main implication is that pretraining recipes should not blindly reuse a fixed tokens-per-parameter rule after changing the tokenizer. The paper’s central result is that compute-optimal model size tracks the amount of data measured in bytes more closely than the amount measured in tokens. As compression increases, the optimal number of tokens per parameter should decrease. This gives tokenizer design a quantitative role in compute allocation: a more compressed tokenizer reduces sequence length and saves FLOPs, but it also makes each token carry more information and can increase modeling difficulty. The contribution is less about proposing a new tokenizer and more about making tokenization part of the scaling-law problem.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main experimental tool is Byte Latent Transformer, because it can vary compression rate without changing vocabulary size. BLT first aggregates byte-level inputs into latent tokens with a local encoder, applies a global Transformer over those latent tokens, and then uses a decoder to predict bytes. This separates compression rate from vocabulary size and avoids the confounding present in subword tokenizers, where token boundaries, vocabulary, parameter count, and compression are coupled. The authors modify the original BLT setup by removing byte n-gram hash embeddings, since such n-grams can span more bytes than a latent token and would interfere with controlled compression. They also adjust the scaling of local modules, favoring width over depth. The scaling analysis then fits laws that include compression rate, comparing data measured in tokens with data measured in bytes. Additional subword-tokenized Transformer experiments test whether the trends are specific to BLT. Multilingual experiments use parity, the byte-length ratio of parallel sentences across languages, to explain shifts in optimal data ratios and compression rates.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental sweep is substantial: 988 BLT models are trained, ranging from 50M to 7B parameters, across multiple target compression rates. The paper explicitly compares this range with common subword regimes, including a popular BPE tokenizer at about 4.57 bytes per token on English DCLM-like text and SuperBPE at about 6.16 bytes per token. The key empirical finding is that, along the compute-optimal frontier, parameter count scales with training data measured in bytes rather than tokens. Equivalently, increasing compression should reduce the optimal tokens-per-parameter ratio. The experiments also show that compression is not free. Higher compression shortens the global sequence and reduces Transformer FLOPs, but each latent token must represent more bytes, increasing local modeling burden and prediction difficulty. This leads to an optimal compression region under a fixed compute budget rather than a monotonic preference for maximum compression. The subword experiments are used as a sanity check against the BLT-only interpretation, while the multilingual experiments show that byte parity matters when transferring English-derived scaling rules to other languages.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the research questions in the introduction carefully; they define the paper as a scaling-law study rather than a tokenizer comparison. In the methodology, focus on the BLT modifications, the way compression rate is controlled, the local-module scaling recipe, and the removal of hash n-gram embeddings. In the experimental sections, prioritize the figures that show scaling curves across compression rates, the compute-optimal frontier relating parameters to tokens and bytes, and the estimated optimal compression rate as compute changes. The subword-tokenizer section is useful for checking whether the BLT observations transfer to standard tokenizer families such as BPE and SuperBPE. The multilingual section is worth reading for its use of parity, since it connects tokenizer fairness and multilingual pretraining allocation. Two details deserve close inspection: how the paper accounts for BLT local-module compute, and how byte-level losses are compared with conventional token-level perplexity.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改 tokenizer scaling 的默认假设：应按 bytes 重画内部 Chinchilla 曲线，并把压缩率纳入 compute-optimal 搜索。
recommendation.en: This changes the tokenizer-scaling prior: redraw internal Chinchilla curves in bytes, and treat compression rate as a compute-optimal search variable.

We show that this view misses two finite-sample biases. First, the gradient and preconditioner are typically estimated from the same minibatch, introducing gradient--preconditioner coupling bias. summary.core_problem: 预训练常用的带预条件的自适应优化器（AdamW、Sophia、Shampoo这类）的随机更新存在两类未被明确研究的有限样本偏差：一是梯度和预条件器用同一小批量估计带来的耦合偏差，二是预条件器求逆/求逆根的非线性操作带来的逆估计偏差。现有研究将随机更新直接视为群体级预条件下降的近似，忽略了这两类偏差，会影响预训练收敛速度和最终效果。
summary.importance: 明确了自适应优化器设计中之前被忽略的两类统计偏差来源，提出的修正框架可直接嵌入常用优化器，不需要改动核心预训练流程，能在几乎无额外成本的前提下降低预训练困惑度，为优化器设计和预训练调优提供了新的可落地维度。
summary.technical_approach: 首先将实际随机预条件更新与理想群体更新的统计差异分解为前述两类偏差，随后提出单批次修正框架，包含两个核心组件：一是交叉拟合预条件，将当前训练batch拆为独立的微批次组，分别估计梯度和预条件器，消除耦合偏差；二是方差校正求逆，利用微批次间的方差抵消逆操作引入的一阶偏差。该框架分别适配了对角二阶矩、对角曲率、矩阵预条件三类主流优化器。
summary.experiments: 在预训练和指令微调任务上测试，修正后的AdamW、Sophia、Shampoo分别在留出集预训练交叉熵上取得0.1489、0.0701、0.1103 nat的下降，三类优化器均获得一致收益，其中AdamW的提升幅度最大。
summary.reading_guide: 推荐优先阅读第2章问题定义和第3章的两类偏差分解，10分钟左右可掌握核心结论。需要落地实现的读者可参考第4章的三类优化器适配细节，理论推导部分可跳过。

summary_en.core_problem: Preconditioned adaptive optimizers widely used in LLM pretraining (e.g., AdamW, Sophia, Shampoo) suffer from two understudied finite-sample biases in their stochastic update rules: coupling bias from estimating gradient and preconditioner on the same minibatch, and inverse estimation bias caused by the nonlinearity of preconditioner inversion or inverse-root operation. Existing work treats stochastic updates as direct approximations of population-level preconditioned descent and ignores these biases, which degrades pretraining convergence and final performance.
summary_en.importance: This work explicitly formalizes two previously unaccounted statistical biases in adaptive optimizer design, and provides a drop-in correction framework that can be integrated into common optimizers without modifying core pretraining pipelines. The consistent perplexity reduction across optimizer families offers a new actionable dimension for pretraining optimization tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, the work statistically decomposes the mismatch between practical stochastic preconditioned updates and ideal population-level updates into the two aforementioned biases. It then proposes a single-batch correction framework with two components: 1) Cross-fitted preconditioning, which splits the training batch into independent microbatch groups to estimate gradient and preconditioner separately to eliminate coupling bias; 2) Variance-corrected inversion, which uses cross-microbatch variance to cancel the first-order bias introduced by preconditioner inversion. The framework is adapted to three representative optimizer families covering diagonal moment, diagonal curvature, and matrix preconditioning.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on pretraining and instruction tuning tasks, the corrected AdamW, Sophia, and Shampoo achieve 0.1489, 0.0701, and 0.1103 nat reductions in held-out pretraining cross-entropy respectively, with consistent gains across all tested optimizer families and the largest improvement observed on AdamW.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a high-level overview, read Chapter 2 (problem setup) and Chapter 3 (bias decomposition), which takes around 10 minutes. Readers looking to implement the correction can refer to Chapter 4 for adapter details for each optimizer; the theoretical derivation sections can be skipped.

recommendation.zh: 做预训练优化器选型或 ablation 的研究员应看 §3-4，两种偏差机制是新发现，但校正方案在大规模训练中的工程可行性（微批量拆分开销）需评估。
recommendation.en: Researchers doing optimizer ablation in pretraining should examine §3-4 for the two bias mechanisms; the correction's engineering feasibility at scale (microbatch splitting overhead) needs evaluation.

paper.title: Decoupling the Benefits of Subword Tokenization for Language Model Training via Byte-level Simulation
paper.abstract: Subword tokenization is an essential part of modern large language models (LLMs), yet its specific contributions to training efficiency and model performance remain poorly understood. In this work, we decouple the effects of subword tokenization by isolating them within a controlled byte-level pretraining pipeline. We formulate and test hypotheses across various dimensions, including sample throughput, vocabulary scaling, and the linguistic prior of subword boundaries. By simulating these effect

summary.core_problem: 子词 tokenizer（BPE/Unigram）相对 byte-level LM 的优势通常被“打包”讨论：序列更短、词表更大、边界更像语义单位、tokenizer 的 look-ahead 让预测更容易等。但这些因素彼此耦合，导致很难回答“到底是哪一项在起主要作用”。这篇论文的核心问题是：在不改变主干 Transformer 架构、尽量不引入额外算力开销的前提下，把子词 tokenization 的潜在收益拆开，在纯 byte-level 训练管线里逐项模拟，从而定量解释 subword–byte 性能差距来自哪里。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于：把“tokenizer 选择”从经验问题推进到可检验的机制问题。论文给出一套可复用的实验范式：固定同一套训练数据与主干架构，用输入/输出侧的轻量改动去模拟 tokenization 带来的吞吐、词表参数规模、边界先验、预测粒度变化，并用统一的 bits-per-byte 指标对齐比较。对后续做 byte-level / tokenizer-free / 多粒度建模的人，这种拆解能更清楚地指导资源该投在吞吐（序列长度/并行效率）、输出层（词表/softmax）、还是建模目标（multi-token prediction、边界先验）。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上采取“byte-level 主干 + 子词效应注入”的思路。基础模型是标准 LLaMA-3 架构（不做 byte LM 常见的卷积/局部编码器下采样），输入是 UTF-8 bytes；训练框架 TorchTitan；数据 FineWeb-Edu。为了在 byte setting 中获得可控的子词信息，作者同时用 LLaMA-3 的 BPE tokenizer 对同一文本做分词，从而得到每个 byte 位置对应的子词边界/分段信息，但训练目标仍以 byte 为基本单位并用 bits-per-byte 统一度量。

论文围绕引言里提出的几类假设，设计一组“几乎不增加计算”的注入手段，目标是把耦合因素拆开：
1) 吞吐/序列压缩效应：子词让序列更短，等价于在同样 token budget 下看到更多原始字节信息；作者在 byte 训练里用受控方式模拟“有效吞吐提升”，以检验性能提升是否主要来自更高的样本处理率而非语言学先验。
2) 词表规模/参数分配效应：子词扩大词表，主要增加 embedding 与输出层参数；作者在 byte setting 中用方式模拟“更大的离散输出空间/更强的输出层容量”，以区分是容量（尤其是输出层）还是序列长度在起作用。
3) 子词边界的结构先验：BPE 边界可能提供接近形态/语义的分块；作者把 BPE 边界作为额外信号注入 byte 模型（例如让模型显式感知边界或在目标上对齐边界），检验这种先验是否能在不改变吞吐的情况下带来泛化收益。
4) tokenizer look-ahead 的任务简化：BPE 分词需要看未来字符决定边界，等价于给了“未来分布的提示”；作者尝试在 byte 任务中模拟这种信息泄露/提示效应，评估它对训练损失与泛化的贡献。
5) 预测粒度变化：预测一个 subword 相当于一次预测多个 byte n-gram；作者引入 multi-token prediction head（一次预测多个后续 byte）来模拟“子词一步多字节”的训练信号，连接到近期 multi-token prediction 能提升下游的结论。

整体取舍很明确：不引入专门的 byte 下采样模块，避免把架构差异混进来；尽量只在输入标注、输出头、训练目标粒度上做改动，从而把因果归因聚焦在 tokenization 相关因素。
summary.experiments:
实验设置的关键点是对齐：同一 1.7B 参数量级、同一 LLaMA-3 主干、同一 FineWeb-Edu 数据、同一验证集，用 bits-per-byte 作为统一指标，避免 subword/byte 因 token 计数不同导致的比较失真。论文主线是把每个“子词效应”单独打开/关闭，观察验证 bpb 与训练动态变化，并做组合实验看可加性/交互。

从全文叙述可以确定的硬信息包括：模型规模 1.7B；数据 FineWeb-Edu；byte 输入为 UTF-8；同时用 LLaMA-3 BPE 得到边界；评估指标为 bits-per-byte cross-entropy。具体提升数字、各假设对应的增益排序、以及是否出现明显的交互项，需要依赖论文后半部分实验章节与附录表格（当前提供的全文片段在“multi-h...”处截断，无法可靠复述精确数值）。建议在精读时把每个实验的“额外计算是否为零/可忽略”与“吞吐是否变化”标出来，因为这是这类归因实验最容易被忽略的混杂因素。
summary.reading_guide:
精读优先级：
- Hypotheses 章节：把作者要拆的变量列清楚，尤其是“吞吐/序列长度”“词表/输出层容量”“边界先验”“look-ahead”“multi-token prediction”这五类是否彼此独立、作者如何定义可检验假设。
- Methodology 章节：逐项看作者如何在 byte setting 中“模拟”子词效应，重点检查两点：①是否真的不引入额外 FLOPs（或引入多少）；②是否改变了有效训练 token/byte 预算（吞吐混杂）。
- 实验主表与消融：把每个注入项的 bpb 改善幅度、训练曲线形态（收敛速度/是否更稳）、以及组合实验的可加性整理成一张表，才能回答“主要收益来自哪里”。
- Appendix（超参、实现细节）：确认 softmax/输出层的实现、multi-token head 的具体形式、以及边界信号的编码方式；这些细节决定结论能否迁移到更大规模或不同 tokenizer。

值得深挖的问题：如果吞吐提升解释了大部分差距，那么 byte-level 的关键瓶颈更像系统与序列建模效率；如果边界先验或 multi-token 头贡献显著，则说明可以在不依赖静态 tokenizer 的情况下，用学习到的分段/多粒度目标逼近子词优势。

summary_en.core_problem: Subword tokenization (BPE/Unigram) consistently outperforms byte-level LMs, but the usual explanations are entangled: shorter sequences (higher effective throughput), larger vocab/output layers, boundary-induced linguistic priors, tokenizer look-ahead effects, and the fact that predicting a subword is effectively predicting multiple bytes at once. The paper’s core goal is to decouple these factors and quantify their individual contributions by simulating subword-induced effects inside a controlled byte-level pretraining pipeline, while keeping the backbone architecture and compute overhead essentially unchanged.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, the main contribution is methodological: it turns tokenizer choice from a largely empirical knob into a set of testable mechanisms with controlled ablations. The “byte backbone + subword-effect injection” framework is reusable for anyone working on byte-level/tokenizer-free LMs, multi-granularity objectives, or alternative output parameterizations. It also clarifies where engineering effort should go: improving effective throughput/sequence efficiency, reallocating capacity in the output layer, or changing the learning signal (e.g., multi-token prediction, boundary priors) rather than debating tokenizers in the abstract.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper fixes a standard LLaMA-3 Transformer backbone (explicitly avoiding typical byte-LM downsampling modules like strided convs or local encoders) and trains on UTF-8 bytes using TorchTitan, with FineWeb-Edu as data. To obtain controllable subword information without switching the modeling unit, the same text is also tokenized with the LLaMA-3 BPE tokenizer to extract subword boundaries/segments aligned to byte positions. Evaluation is unified via bits-per-byte cross-entropy on a held-out FineWeb-Edu validation split.

On top of the byte baseline, the authors introduce a series of low-overhead interventions, each designed to mimic one hypothesized benefit of subword tokenization while minimizing confounders:
- Throughput/sequence compression: simulate the advantage of shorter sequences (more raw bytes seen per unit compute) within the byte pipeline.
- Vocabulary/output-layer scaling: simulate the capacity effects associated with larger discrete vocabularies, focusing on embedding/output-layer parameterization.
- Boundary priors: inject BPE boundary signals as explicit structure so the model can exploit segmentation-like cues without changing the base unit.
- Look-ahead/task easiness: approximate the “future hint” implicit in subword segmentation decisions that require looking ahead.
- Multi-byte prediction: add multi-token (multi-byte) prediction heads to emulate the fact that one subword prediction corresponds to predicting a byte n-gram.

The design choice is deliberate: keep the backbone and most hyperparameters fixed, and localize changes to input annotations, output heads, and objective granularity so attribution stays focused on tokenization-related factors.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental backbone is tightly controlled: a 1.7B-parameter LLaMA-3 architecture, FineWeb-Edu training data, UTF-8 byte inputs, BPE-derived boundary annotations, and a shared bits-per-byte metric for fair comparison across tokenization regimes. The main results are organized as ablations where each simulated effect is toggled on/off, plus combination runs to test additivity and interactions.

From the provided full-text excerpt, the reliably extractable specifics are: 1.7B model size; FineWeb-Edu; UTF-8 bytes; LLaMA-3 BPE used for boundary extraction; bits-per-byte validation loss. Exact numeric gains per intervention and their ranking require the later experimental sections/tables (the supplied content is truncated mid-method section), so they should be read directly from the main result tables and ablation figures.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Where to spend time:
- Hypotheses: verify how each factor is defined and what would count as evidence for/against it.
- Methodology: for every intervention, check (1) whether it truly adds negligible FLOPs and (2) whether it changes the effective byte budget/throughput—these are the two biggest sources of confounding in tokenizer studies.
- Main ablation tables/figures: extract per-factor bpb improvements, convergence speed changes, and whether effects are additive.
- Appendix: implementation details of the output layer, multi-token head, and boundary encoding; these determine how portable the conclusions are.

A useful follow-up question while reading: if throughput explains most of the gap, byte LMs are primarily a systems/sequence-efficiency problem; if boundary priors or multi-token heads contribute materially, then learned segmentation or objective design may recover much of subword’s advantage without a static tokenizer.

recommendation.zh: 应读实验设计；它把“BPE 更好”拆成吞吐和边界先验两个可控因子，值得放进 tokenizer ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental design; it decomposes “BPE works better” into throughput and boundary-prior effects that are worth reproducing in tokenizer ablations.

paper.title: HRM-Text: Efficient Pretraining Beyond Scaling

In contrast, biological systems demonstrate highly sample-efficient learning through multi-timescale processing, such as the functional organization of the frontoparietal loop. summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答两个更根本的问题。第一，语言模型预训练是否必须依赖 Transformer + 海量原始文本 + next-token 这一套高算力配方，还是可以通过更强的结构归纳偏置和更贴近使用场景的训练目标，在小得多的 token 与算力预算下得到可用的通用能力。第二，若采用深层递归、双时间尺度的 HRM 架构，怎样解决语言建模中最棘手的训练稳定性问题，避免 recurrent depth 带来的梯度消失、爆炸和信用分配失效。论文的核心不是单点提速，而是试图给出一个“低预算也能做从零预训练”的存在性证明。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究，这篇工作的重要性高于一般架构改造。它同时挑战了三件被默认接受的东西：一是 Transformer 作为唯一可行的大规模语言建模骨架；二是 raw-text autoregressive pretraining 作为唯一主路径；三是只有极大 token 预算才值得做从零训练。作者给出的结果如果站得住，意义不在于 HRM-Text 已经全面优于主流开源模型，而在于它把研究问题重新打开了：结构先验、训练目标和数据形态的选择，可能比继续沿着同一 recipe 做线性放大更影响小中规模预算下的 compute-to-performance ratio。对数据效率、PrefixLM、instruction-first pretraining、非 Transformer 语言建模、以及 pretrain/post-train 边界重划，这篇都有直接启发。贡献量级属于“值得精读并复核实验设置”的那一类，因为它触碰的是范式假设，而不是局部技巧。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线由架构与目标两部分组成，而且两者是联动设计，不是简单相加。架构上，HRM-Text 采用双时间尺度递归：慢速 H 模块负责较稳定的高层语义状态，快速 L 模块负责局部迭代细化。一次前向包含两个 high-level cycle，每个 cycle 内执行三次 L 更新再执行一次 H 更新，最终用最后的 H 状态输出 token logits。这样做的意图是用重复计算换参数规模，让模型在较少参数和较少数据下仍有较深的推理/整合过程。问题在于，重复应用同一变换会把 Transformer 中 norm placement 的老问题放大。为此作者引入 MagicNorm 和 warmup deep credit assignment。根据正文描述，MagicNorm 试图兼顾 PreNorm 与 PostNorm 的优点：既约束前向激活方差，避免递归堆叠时状态发散，又尽量保留稳定的梯度通路，减少深递归下的优化困难。配套上使用 parameterless RMSNorm、SwiGLU、RoPE 和 sigmoid-gated self-attention，说明作者在尽量压缩不必要自由度，优先保训练稳定。warmup deep credit assignment 则是一个很关键但容易被忽略的训练技巧：训练初期只对最后 2 个 recurrent step 回传梯度，随后再扩展到最后 5 步，等于显式控制有效反向深度，先学短程信用分配，再逐步放开长程依赖。这和 curriculum on optimization depth 很像，是递归 LM 能否训起来的关键之一。

目标函数上，作者没有走标准 raw-text next-token，而是直接从 instruction-response pairs 做 task-completion pretraining，只在 response token 上计算 NLL，即优化 -log P(x_a | x_q)。同时配 PrefixLM mask，让 instruction 部分双向可见、response 部分保持因果生成。这里的设计选择很鲜明：既然模型最终大多用于条件生成，就不再把大量算力花在预测 prompt-like 文本、网页噪声或任务无关续写上，而是把训练信号集中到“给定条件，完成回答”这件事。和纯 encoder-decoder 不同，PrefixLM 仍保留单流生成接口；和标准 causal LM 不同，它允许 instruction 侧更充分的信息整合。论文真正有意思的地方在于，它不是只换了一个 mask，而是把数据形态、损失定义和架构归纳偏置一起改了，形成一个面向 sample efficiency 的整体 recipe。
summary.experiments:
论文最醒目的结果是预算对比。作者声称 HRM-Text 从零训练只使用 40B unique tokens，却能在多数 benchmark 上进入 Llama、Qwen、Gemma、OLMo、Ouro、Huginn 等 contemporaries 的性能区间，而这些基线通常使用约 100–900× 更多训练 token、96–432× 更多估算训练算力。这个数字如果按文中口径成立，说明它不是常规意义上的“小幅数据效率提升”，而是在低预算区间显著改变了可行边界。需要注意，作者强调的是“performance neighborhood”而非全面超越，因此解读时要看具体 benchmark 分布，而不是只看平均分。

从正文可重点关注三类实验。第一类是稳定性与训练动力学：MagicNorm 与 warmup deep credit assignment 的消融，应该会展示没有这些设计时训练发散、loss 不稳或最终性能明显下降。这里要看的是 loss curve、梯度/激活统计，以及不同反传步数设置对收敛的影响。第二类是目标函数消融：instruction-response only、response-only loss、PrefixLM mask 相对标准 causal LM/raw text 训练的差异。这部分决定论文的“Beyond Scaling”到底主要来自架构，还是主要来自更聚焦的数据与目标。第三类是 compute/data efficiency 对比：在相近参数规模或相近训练预算下，与开源基线的 benchmark 对照。摘要里没有给出完整参数量，但正文提到的比较对象覆盖多个主流开源系列，因此应重点核对是否做了公平的 token、参数、训练步数和数据质量对齐。若表 4 和图 1 是主结果，建议逐项看清：比较的是 unique tokens 还是 seen tokens，compute 是实测还是估算，benchmark 是否偏 instruction-following，从而避免把“任务形式更匹配”误读成“通用语言能力全面替代”。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇需要精读。先看 Introduction，把作者要挑战的三个默认前提抓住：Transformer 唯一路径、raw-text AR 唯一路径、超大预算是必要条件。然后直接读方法里关于 HRM forward schedule 的描述，弄清楚 H/L 两层递归到底如何交替更新；如果这一点没看明白，后面的稳定性设计就会显得抽象。接着重点读稳定化部分，也就是 MagicNorm 与 warmup deep credit assignment。这里是论文最可能被低估、也最值得复现验证的地方，因为很多递归架构不是想法不成立，而是训练训不起来。建议把 norm 公式、残差路径、反向深度调度和对应消融图一起看。

第二个重点是目标函数部分：为什么只在 response 上算 loss，为什么用 PrefixLM 而不是标准 causal mask，作者如何论证 raw text 中大量 token 对其目标是低效甚至干扰的。这里要带着怀疑去读：这种 recipe 是否只是更贴近 instruction benchmark，因此在某些评测上占优，还是确实提升了更一般的 sample efficiency。

实验部分优先看主表、训练稳定性消融、以及与开源模型的 token/compute 对比表。若时间有限，至少看图 1、表 4、稳定性消融图和目标函数消融表。预计需要 60–90 分钟才能形成可靠判断。值得深挖的点有三个：一，双时间尺度递归是否提供了可扩展的 test-time compute 空间；二，response-only pretraining 是否会损伤世界知识覆盖与非指令文本建模；三，40B instruction-response 数据的构成、去重和质量控制是否才是结果的更大来源。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles two foundational questions. First, does language-model pretraining really require the standard recipe of Transformer + massive raw text + next-token prediction, or can stronger structural priors and a more usage-aligned objective deliver competitive capability under far smaller token and compute budgets? Second, if one replaces the Transformer with a deeply recurrent, dual-timescale architecture, how can training be stabilized so that recurrence depth does not collapse optimization through exploding/vanishing gradients and poor credit assignment? The work is not about a small efficiency tweak; it is trying to establish that low-budget training from scratch may still be a meaningful research path.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, this is more consequential than a routine architecture variant. It simultaneously questions three defaults: Transformer as the only viable backbone, raw-text autoregressive pretraining as the only serious objective, and very large token budgets as a prerequisite for useful from-scratch training. If the empirical claims hold, the significance is not that HRM-Text already dominates mainstream open models, but that it reopens the design space. Structural bias, objective choice, and data form may matter more for the compute-to-performance ratio in modest-budget regimes than simply scaling the same recipe. The paper is directly relevant to data efficiency, PrefixLM-style conditioning, instruction-first pretraining, non-Transformer language modeling, and the blurry boundary between pretraining and post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is a coupled redesign of architecture and objective rather than an isolated component swap. On the architecture side, HRM-Text uses dual-timescale recurrence: a slow H module maintains a relatively stable high-level semantic state, while a fast L module performs local iterative refinement. One forward pass consists of two high-level cycles; each cycle runs three L updates followed by one H update, and token logits are produced from the final H state. The intended trade-off is clear: use repeated computation instead of proportionally increasing parameter count, so the model can perform deeper integration under smaller budgets.

The hard part is optimization. Repeatedly applying the same transformation amplifies the classic normalization-placement problem already familiar from Transformers. The paper introduces MagicNorm and warmup deep credit assignment to make this viable. From the full text, MagicNorm is designed to preserve bounded forward activation variance while keeping backward optimization stable, effectively trying to capture the good parts of both PreNorm and PostNorm under recurrence. The surrounding design choices—parameterless RMSNorm, SwiGLU, RoPE, and sigmoid-gated self-attention—suggest a deliberate bias toward stability and reduced unnecessary flexibility. Warmup deep credit assignment is especially important: early in training, gradients are backpropagated only through the final two recurrent steps, and later expanded to the final five. This explicitly controls effective backward depth, allowing the model to first learn short-range credit assignment before exposing it to longer recurrent dependencies.

On the objective side, the paper abandons standard raw-text next-token pretraining. HRM-Text is trained from scratch on instruction-response pairs, with NLL computed only on the response tokens, i.e. optimizing -log P(x_a | x_q). This is paired with a PrefixLM mask: full bidirectional attention over the instruction prefix, causal generation over the response. The motivation is sharp. If the model is mostly used for conditional generation at inference time, then spending most of the budget predicting prompt-like text, web boilerplate, or task-irrelevant continuations may be wasteful. Compared with encoder-decoder training, PrefixLM preserves a single-stream generative interface; compared with standard causal LM, it allows richer integration over the conditioning context. The interesting part is that the paper changes data form, loss support, and architectural prior together into one sample-efficiency-oriented recipe.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result is the budget comparison. The authors claim that HRM-Text, trained from scratch on only 40B unique tokens, reaches the performance neighborhood of contemporary open models such as Llama, Qwen, Gemma, OLMo, Ouro, and Huginn on most benchmarks, while using roughly 100–900× fewer training tokens and 96–432× less estimated training compute. If those numbers are supported under fair accounting, this is not a routine gain in data efficiency; it materially changes what is feasible in the low-budget regime. The wording matters, though: the claim is about entering the same performance band on many benchmarks, not uniformly surpassing those baselines.

Three experimental blocks deserve close attention. First, stability and training dynamics: ablations for MagicNorm and warmup deep credit assignment should reveal whether training diverges, becomes noisy, or converges to much worse solutions without them. Loss curves, activation/gradient statistics, and sensitivity to backprop depth are central here. Second, objective ablations: instruction-response-only training, response-only loss, and PrefixLM masking versus standard causal LM or raw-text training. This determines whether the gains come mainly from the architecture or from a more focused data/objective design. Third, compute and data efficiency comparisons against open baselines under roughly matched parameter scales or training budgets. The paper’s main figure and token/compute table should be read carefully: unique tokens versus seen tokens, measured versus estimated compute, and whether the benchmark suite is especially favorable to instruction-conditioned models. That distinction matters when interpreting “beyond scaling.”
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one deserves a full read. Start with the introduction and isolate the three assumptions being challenged: Transformer as the only path, raw-text AR as the only path, and extreme budget as a necessity. Then move directly to the HRM forward schedule and make sure the H/L update pattern is fully clear; otherwise the stabilization section will feel opaque. The next priority is the stabilization machinery—MagicNorm and warmup deep credit assignment. That is likely the most underappreciated part of the paper and the part most worth reproducing, because many recurrent language-model ideas fail not conceptually but optimization-wise. Read the normalization equations, residual pathways, backward-depth schedule, and the corresponding ablations together.

The second major section to study is the objective design: why compute loss only on the response, why use PrefixLM instead of a standard causal mask, and how the paper argues that much of raw-text prediction is inefficient for its target use case. Read this skeptically. The key question is whether the recipe genuinely improves general sample efficiency or simply aligns better with instruction-heavy evaluations.

In the experiments, prioritize the main result table, the stability ablations, and the token/compute comparison against open models. If time is limited, at least read Figure 1, Table 4, the stabilization ablation figures, and the objective ablation table. Expect 60–90 minutes for a reliable judgment. Three follow-up questions are especially worth digging into: whether dual-timescale recurrence opens a scalable test-time compute axis, whether response-only pretraining weakens broad world-modeling coverage, and how much of the result is actually driven by the composition and quality control of the 40B instruction-response corpus.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接碰你的 prior：原始文本 AR 预训练未必是唯一高效路径；先查 baseline 是否同等 compute、instruction-only 数据是否泄漏任务分布，若对比干净，建议立刻做小规模复现。
recommendation.en: This one directly challenges the prior that raw-text AR pretraining is the only efficient path; first audit compute parity and task-distribution leakage in the instruction-only data, and if the setup is clean, reproduce it at small scale immediately.

summary.core_problem: 文章讨论大模型预训练里的数据配比搜索：通用文本、数学、代码、多语言等语料该如何混合，才能在不反复重训整模的前提下，较便宜地找到更好的配方。
summary.key_insights: 核心信息有两点。第一，DeMix 试图把“配比搜索”与“完整训练”解耦：先训练单域模型，再通过模型合并去近似不同数据混合比例下的效果，用秒级合并替代一次次昂贵重训。文中给出的关键信号是，合并得到的性能排序与真实混合训练有较高一致性（ρ=0.81），并声称同等精度下可把搜索成本降到约 1/6。第二，作者把这个思路从预训练延伸到 mid-training 和 SFT，说明它不只是一个静态数据配方工具，而是在更广义的训练阶段配比选择上都有潜在用途。附带开源的 DeMix Corpora 也有一定参考价值，尤其是三阶段提升数学和代码占比的配方设计。
summary.limits: 这是一篇社交平台短笔记，信息密度有限，很多关键前提没有展开：模型合并近似真实混合训练的边界条件是什么，在哪些架构、规模、域间差异下会失效，ρ=0.81 对最终选配方是否足够稳定，都还需要回到论文和代码核实。另一个需要谨慎的点是，排序一致不等于绝对性能可精确预测，因此更适合作为候选筛选器，而不是完全替代真实训练。

summary_en.core_problem: This post is about data-mixture search for LLM pretraining: how to choose the proportions of general text, math, code, and multilingual data without repeatedly training full models from scratch.
summary_en.key_insights: The main idea behind DeMix is to decouple mixture search from full pretraining. Instead of retraining a model for every candidate recipe, it trains domain-specific models and uses model merging to approximate the outcome of different corpus mixtures. The post highlights two concrete claims: the ranking of merged candidates correlates well with real mixed-training results (rho = 0.81), and the search cost can drop by roughly 6x at similar accuracy. It also suggests the same recipe-search logic may transfer beyond pretraining into mid-training and even SFT, which makes it more interesting than a one-off corpus engineering trick. The released DeMix Corpora is also useful as a practical reference, especially the staged schedule that increases math and code over time.
summary_en.limits: This is still a short social-media summary, so the important caveats are missing. It does not explain when model merging is a good proxy for true mixed-domain training, how sensitive the method is to architecture and scale, or whether the correlation is stable enough for final recipe selection. A good ranking signal is helpful, but it is not the same as accurately predicting absolute downstream quality. Treat it as a promising search heuristic until the paper and code are checked in detail.

paper.title: Scaling Laws for Mixture Pretraining Under Data Constraints
paper.abstract: As language models scale, the amount of data they require grows -- yet many target data sources, such as low-resource languages or specialized domains, are inherently limited in size. summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个很具体、但在真实预训练里经常被回避的问题：当目标数据源本身无法扩展时，预训练时应该给它多大混合权重，允许它被重复多少次，才能在目标域收益和过拟合之间取得最好平衡。这里的“目标数据”不是单一类型，而是三类常见受限来源：低资源语言、专业领域语料、以及高质量筛选子集。已有 data-constrained scaling law 主要研究单一数据源反复训练，结论通常是 4 次重复左右接近上限；已有 data mixing 工作则默认每个数据源都近似无限。这个工作处理的是两者之间的空白地带：一个源受限、另一个源充足，而且训练预算固定。论文要回答的不是“重复会不会坏”，而是“在混合训练里，重复的代价和收益如何随模型规模、目标数据规模、训练 token 预算共同变化，以及能否形成可外推的定量规律”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义很直接。第一，它把“有限高价值数据如何配比”从经验问题推进成了可拟合、可预测的问题。很多实际训练场景都符合这个设定，比如低资源语言继续预训练、代码/数学/科学语料注入、以及高质量数据占比控制。第二，它修正了一个常见但过于粗糙的工程经验：单源训练里 4 次重复常被当作上限，但在 mixture pretraining 中，只要通用数据持续提供新 token，目标数据的最优重复次数可以显著更高，论文里多处达到 15–20 次，而且并不必然伤害目标域表现。第三，它给出了一个可从小规模实验拟合、再外推到更大模型和更大预算的 scaling law，这对数据预算规划很有用：不必先做大规模网格搜索，就能估算目标数据该采多少、混多少、重复多少。贡献量级上，它不是提出新架构，而是把一个高频工程决策问题做成了系统经验规律和预测工具，这类工作对大规模预训练配方的影响往往比单点技巧更稳。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，论文把问题形式化为两源混合训练。目标域有固定唯一 token 数 D_target，总训练预算是 D_total，目标域在训练中的占比为 h。于是目标域平均重复次数 r 由 h、D_total、D_target 共同决定；通用域被视为足够大，不发生重复。核心建模对象是目标域 loss 如何依赖模型规模 N、目标数据规模 D_target、以及目标域训练 token 数 h·D_total，或者等价地依赖重复次数 r。

经验层面，作者做了大规模 sweep：超过 2000 次训练，模型规模从 101M 到 805M，覆盖多种目标数据大小和多种数据类型。数据设置分三类。多语言：以 FineWeb2 中德语为主，人工截断到 50M、100M、500M、1B token，并设无限数据对照；通用域是英语 FineWeb。还在法语和斯瓦希里语上做验证。多领域：目标域包括 OpenWebMath、Wikipedia、peS2o 科学论文等，通用域来自 DCLM、FineWeb、Nemotron-CC 等。质量过滤：对 DCLM 用 fastText 质量分类器打分，取 top 1/5/10/20% 作为“高质量但受限”的目标域，再与其余更充足数据混合。这样设计的好处是，它不是只在“英语+某专业语料”上得出结论，而是测试规律是否跨语言、跨领域、跨质量筛选机制稳定。

论文的关键观察有几个。其一，重复带来的收益是平滑递减的，而不是到某个阈值突然失效；过拟合也不是简单由重复次数单独决定，而是由“重复次数 × 模型规模 × 训练预算”共同塑造。其二，在 mixture setting 下，通用域持续提供新 token，会延缓单源重复训练中的退化，因此目标域可以承受远高于单源训练经验上限的重复。其三，大模型一方面更容易在目标域验证集上出现过拟合拐点，另一方面也更能从有限目标数据中榨出收益；也就是“学得更快，也更容易过头”。

在此基础上，作者拟合了一个目标域 loss 的 scaling law。虽然全文给出的具体函数形式带有若干可学习系数，但思想很清楚：把目标域 loss 分解为若干随模型规模、目标唯一数据量、目标域训练暴露量变化的幂律项，并显式建模重复导致的收益递减。这个形式既能覆盖“更多唯一数据更好”，也能覆盖“同一批数据重复仍有价值，但边际收益下降”。作者用小模型、小预算子集拟合参数，再外推到更大模型和更大预算，检验是否能预测最优 h 或最优 r。论文还把框架扩展到两个都受限的目标域，讨论多受限源之间如何分配预算。
summary.experiments:
实验是这篇文章最有分量的部分。规模上，全文报告了 2000+ 次训练运行，模型从 101M 到 805M。多语言主实验里，德语目标数据规模覆盖 50M、100M、500M、1B token 以及 unconstrained 对照；法语和斯瓦希里语用于验证规律是否迁移。多领域实验里，OpenWebMath 目标数据规模为 10M、100M、1B；Wikipedia 与 peS2o 也做了从千万到数十亿 token 的受限设置。质量过滤实验则把 DCLM 的 top 1%、5%、10%、20% 高质量子集当作受限目标域。

最关键的结果有三类。第一，最优重复次数远高于单源训练常见的 4 次经验值。论文在多个设置下都观察到，若目标是提升目标域表现，最优重复可达到 15–20 次。这个结论在低资源语言、专业领域和高质量子集三类数据上都成立，但具体最优点会随 D_target 和 D_total 改变。第二，随着训练预算增加，最优目标域占比 h 会下降，但最优重复次数 r 往往上升。原因是总训练 token 更多时，即便 h 变小，固定大小的目标数据仍会被见到更多轮。这一点很重要：固定“混合比例”不是稳健策略，预算变了，最优比例也会变。第三，larger model 在同样目标数据规模下通常能从更高重复中继续获益，但验证 loss 的过拟合拐点也更早出现，因此最优点更尖锐，配比更需要精调。

scaling law 的预测能力是另一项关键结果。作者展示了用较小规模实验拟合得到的参数，可以较准确地预测更大规模下目标域 loss 曲线以及最优重复次数/混合权重，而不需要在大规模上重新做完整 sweep。文中还比较了不同数据类型下拟合残差，说明规律并非只在某一个语料族上成立。对于两个受限目标域的扩展实验，结果表明该框架仍能给出合理的预算分配趋势：更小、更稀缺、但更相关的目标域通常需要更高的单位数据暴露，但也更快进入收益递减区间。

如果看消融和图表，Figure 1/2 直接展示了“重复次数—目标域性能—过拟合”之间的关系，是全文最先要看的结果图。后续关于不同模型规模、不同 D_target、不同数据类型的曲线，支持了“规律稳定但最优点可移动”这一判断。扩展到双受限域的章节则更像方法边界测试，说明这个 law 不只适用于 one-target-one-generic 的最简情形。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先读 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2，把论文真正回答的问题钉住：不是泛泛讨论 data mixing，而是在固定训练预算下，研究受限目标数据的最优暴露量。然后重点看 Methodology 里变量定义，尤其是 D_target、D_total、h、r 之间的关系。很多读者会把“混合比例”和“重复次数”混为一谈，这篇文章的价值恰恰在于把两者放进同一个坐标系里。

精读时最值得盯的有四处。第一，主实验图里最优点如何随模型规模和预算移动。这里能直接看到为什么固定 5% 或 10% 的 target ratio 不是通用策略。第二，scaling law 的函数形式和拟合流程。重点不是记公式，而是看它如何把唯一数据量和重复暴露拆开建模，以及小规模拟合为何能外推。第三，多语言、多领域、质量过滤三类实验的共性与差异。共性说明规律稳，差异说明参数不是通用常数。第四，双受限目标域扩展。这个部分对真实配方设计更接近，因为很多训练并不是“一个稀缺域 + 一个无限域”，而是多个都稀缺。

如果时间有限，优先看：Introduction、实验设置表、Figure 1/2、scaling law 拟合与外推结果、双目标域扩展。预计 45–60 分钟可以抓住主要结论；若要把它变成可执行配方，需要再仔细看附录里的拟合细节、不同数据族的参数稳定性，以及作者如何定义目标域评测集。最值得深挖的问题有两个：一是这个 law 是否能迁移到更大模型区间，尤其是数十 B 以上；二是当 generic data 也不是“无限新鲜”而是存在自身重复时，规律会如何变化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical pretraining regime that is common in real systems but poorly characterized in prior scaling-law work: one data source is scarce but valuable, while the other is abundant and generic. The question is how much of the fixed training budget should be allocated to the scarce target source, which directly determines how many times those target tokens are repeated. Too little target exposure under-trains the target domain; too much causes diminishing returns and eventual overfitting. Prior work on data-constrained training mostly considered repeating a single monolithic dataset, often leading to the rule of thumb that around four repetitions is near the useful limit. Prior work on data mixture optimization usually assumes every source is effectively unlimited. This paper fills the gap between those two settings and asks how model size, target-data size, and compute budget jointly determine the optimal repetition level in mixture pretraining.
summary_en.importance: This is important because it turns a recurring recipe-design problem into something measurable and, to some extent, predictable. Many pretraining scenarios fit this setup: low-resource language adaptation, domain injection for math/science/code, and mixing a small high-quality subset with a large generic corpus. The main empirical correction is that the familiar single-source repetition ceiling does not transfer to mixture training. When fresh generic tokens continue to arrive, the scarce target source can often be repeated much more aggressively, with optimal target-task repetition reaching roughly 15–20x in several settings. That changes how one should think about curriculum design, mixture weights, and data budgeting. The second contribution is a fitted scaling law that can be estimated at small scale and extrapolated to larger models and budgets, reducing the need for expensive large-scale sweeps. The paper does not introduce a new architecture; its value is in making a high-frequency pretraining decision more quantitative.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is a two-source mixture. The target source has a fixed number of unique tokens D_target, the total training budget is D_total, and h is the fraction of training tokens drawn from the target source. This induces a repetition factor r for the target source, while the generic source is assumed large enough to avoid repetition. The modeling goal is to predict target-domain loss as a function of model size, target-data size, and target exposure under a fixed compute budget.

The empirical study is broad: more than 2,000 training runs, model sizes from 101M to 805M parameters, and several target-data regimes. The paper covers three families of constrained data. For multilingual experiments, German from FineWeb2 is artificially capped at 50M, 100M, 500M, and 1B tokens, with English FineWeb as the abundant generic source; French and Swahili are used to test whether the pattern is language-specific. For domain mixtures, the target source includes OpenWebMath, Wikipedia, and peS2o, mixed with larger generic corpora such as DCLM, FineWeb, and Nemotron-CC. For quality-filtered mixtures, the authors score DCLM documents with a FastText quality classifier and treat the top 1/5/10/20% subsets as scarce high-quality targets.

The main empirical pattern is that repetition has smooth diminishing returns rather than a hard threshold, and the useful repetition range depends jointly on model size, target-data size, and total budget. Larger models overfit the target validation set sooner, but they also extract more value from limited target data before that point. The presence of fresh generic data changes the regime relative to single-source repetition: it keeps the model learning from new tokens even while the target source is being revisited many times.

On top of these observations, the paper fits a scaling law for target-domain loss. The exact parameterization is learned from data, but the conceptual structure is clear: it separates the effect of unique target data from the effect of repeated target exposure, and models both with smooth power-law-like terms. The law is then used to predict the optimal mixture weight or repetition count. The framework is also extended to the case of two scarce target domains, where the problem becomes one of allocating limited exposure across multiple constrained sources.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental section is the core of the paper. It reports 2,000+ runs with models ranging from 101M to 805M parameters. In the multilingual setting, German target data spans 50M, 100M, 500M, and 1B tokens plus an unconstrained reference; French and Swahili are used as additional checks. In the domain setting, OpenWebMath is capped at 10M, 100M, and 1B tokens, and Wikipedia and peS2o are also studied under constrained budgets. In the quality-filtering setting, top-ranked DCLM subsets are treated as scarce high-quality targets.

Three results matter most. First, the optimal repetition count in mixture pretraining is often far above the familiar single-source heuristic. For target-domain performance, the paper repeatedly finds useful optima around 15–20 repetitions in several settings. Second, as the total compute budget grows, the optimal target fraction h tends to decrease, while the optimal repetition count r can still increase, because the same fixed target pool is revisited more times over a longer run. This is a subtle but operationally important point: a fixed mixture ratio is not compute-invariant. Third, larger models can benefit from higher repetition on scarce target data, but their optimum is sharper because overfitting arrives sooner on the target validation set.

The scaling-law validation is another major result. Parameters fitted on smaller-scale runs are shown to extrapolate reasonably well to larger scales, predicting target-domain loss curves and the optimal repetition level without re-running a full large-scale sweep. The paper also reports that the qualitative pattern holds across multilingual, domain-specific, and quality-filtered mixtures, which suggests the phenomenon is not tied to one corpus family. The two-scarce-domain extension further shows that the framework can provide sensible allocation trends when more than one valuable source is data-limited.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the first two figures. They establish the actual question: not generic data mixing, but optimal exposure of a scarce target source under a fixed compute budget. Then read the setup carefully, especially the relationship among D_target, D_total, h, and r. A common failure mode is to think only in terms of mixture ratio; the paper is stronger when read through the lens of induced repetition.

For a close read, focus on four parts. First, the main result plots showing how the optimum moves with model size and budget. This is where the paper makes clear why a fixed target ratio is not a robust recipe. Second, the scaling-law form and fitting procedure. The key is not memorizing the equation, but understanding how the law separates unique-data effects from repeated-exposure effects. Third, compare the multilingual, domain, and quality-filtered sections to see what is stable and what is dataset-specific. Fourth, read the extension to two constrained target domains; that section is closer to real recipe design than the simplest one-target-plus-generic setup.

If time is limited, read the introduction, the experimental setup, Figures 1 and 2, the scaling-law extrapolation results, and the multi-target extension. That is enough to capture the main contribution in under an hour. If the goal is to operationalize the result, spend more time on the appendix details for fitting, parameter stability across data families, and the exact target-domain evaluation protocol. Two follow-up questions are especially worth thinking about: whether the law still holds at much larger model scales, and how it changes when the generic source is not truly fresh and also begins to repeat.

recommendation.zh: 这篇应进 internal data-mixture ablation：15–20 次重复仍可最优，直接修正低资源/域数据只少量重放的保守 prior。
recommendation.en: Put this into internal data-mixture ablations: 15–20 repeats being optimal directly weakens the usual conservative replay prior for scarce domains.

paper.title: Dense vs Sparse Pretraining at Tiny Scale: Active-Parameter vs Total-Parameter Matching

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的是一个很具体但常被混淆的问题：在极小规模预训练条件下，MoE 相比 dense 到底有没有真实建模收益，以及比较 dense 与 sparse 时应当按 active parameters 还是 total parameters 做公平匹配。作者把系统、数据、tokenizer、优化器、训练日程都固定，只替换 FFN 为 Mixtral 风格的 routed experts，试图把“条件计算本身的建模价值”从大规模分布式训练的工程因素里剥离出来。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义在于，它把 dense-vs-sparse 讨论里最容易混在一起的两种公平性标准拆开了。若按每 token 实际激活的参数量比较，MoE 在 tiny scale 已经能带来明确收益；若按总存储参数量比较，dense 仍略强，但差距不大且会随训练缩小。这个结论不大，却很干净。它说明 sparse 的优势并不只存在于超大规模集群和高系统优化场景，至少在建模层面，条件计算在小模型上已经可见；但同时也说明，若总参数预算固定，MoE 并不会自动胜出。对做 scaling、架构搜索和小规模先导实验的人，这种区分很有用，因为它直接影响实验结论该如何外推。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计相当克制。基础模型是 decoder-only、LLaMA 风格训练栈，数据用 TinyStories，保持 tokenizer、数据管线、优化器、schedule、depth、context length、normalization 和评测协议一致。稀疏化只发生在 FFN：把 dense FFN 换成 Mixtral 风格 MoE 模块。主配方是 4 experts、top-2 routing、dropless dispatch、Switch 风格 load balancing，并可选 router z-loss。作者明确不用 token dropping 或 capacity truncation，目的是避免把执行路径上的近似技巧混进建模比较。损失函数由三部分组成：next-token cross-entropy、负载均衡辅助项 L_bal，以及可选的 router z-loss L_z；最佳稀疏配方里 λ_bal=1e-2，λ_z=1e-3。公平性上做了两组 dense baseline：active-match dense 把宽度调到与 MoE 的每 token 激活参数量接近；total-match dense 则把总参数量调到与完整 MoE 接近。文中给出的 headline 配置是：dense active-match 约 14.89M 参数；MoE 总参数约 21.06M、active 参数约 14.77M；dense total-match 约 21.06M。active 匹配误差小于 1%，total 匹配误差小于 0.1%。这使得结论更容易解释：如果你关心的是每 token 实际动用了多少容量，MoE 的条件路由有优势；如果你关心的是总存储容量，dense 仍然很有竞争力。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有三层。第一，naive sparse 在 tiny scale 并不自然成立。top-1 routing 且不加 balancing 时，训练几乎立刻 collapse，多数层把几乎所有 token 都路由到单一 expert。第二，稳定训练的关键不是单一技巧，而是一个小组合：加入 Switch-style balancing 可以先消除立即塌缩；在此基础上，从 top-1 改到 top-2 带来主要质量提升；router z-loss 更多改善路由行为和稳定性诊断，而不是最终验证损失的主要来源。第三，headline 数字很清楚：三种 full-data、三随机种子的比较中，dense active-match 的最佳验证 loss 为 1.6545 ± 0.0012，MoE 为 1.5788 ± 0.0020，dense total-match 为 1.5608 ± 0.00x（摘要截断了最后一位，但可确定略优于 MoE）。也就是说，MoE 相比 active-match dense 明显更好，但相比 total-match dense 仍略差。作者还强调，这个 sparse gain 伴随着健康的 routing diagnostics，而不是靠病态专家使用换来的假收益。主指标是 held-out validation loss 和 perplexity，吞吐与单 GPU dispatch 优化只放在附录，不作为核心论据。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议很明确。先看 Introduction 和 Method，把两种 fairness 定义记牢：active-parameter matching 回答的是“同等每 token 激活容量下，条件计算是否更有效”；total-parameter matching 回答的是“同等总存储容量下，稀疏化是否值得”。然后直接看 Results 里关于 top-1 collapse、load balancing、top-2 改善、z-loss 作用的几组表和图。若只花 20 到 30 分钟，最值得抓住的是 headline loss 对比和 routing diagnostics，因为这两部分共同决定结论是否可信。若要进一步深挖，可看附录中的 dispatch 实现、吞吐分析，以及不同层 expert usage 的分布图，判断这些结论在更大规模上哪些可能保持、哪些可能被系统因素改写。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper isolates a specific question that is often blurred in dense-vs-sparse discussions: at tiny pretraining scale, does MoE provide a real modeling benefit over dense transformers, and should fairness be defined by active parameters or total parameters? To answer that, the authors keep the tokenizer, data, optimizer, schedule, depth, context length, normalization, and evaluation fixed, and only replace dense FFNs with Mixtral-style routed experts. The goal is to separate the modeling value of conditional computation from large-scale distributed systems effects.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is conceptual cleanliness rather than scale. The paper separates two fairness criteria that often get conflated. Under active-parameter matching, MoE already shows a clear advantage even at tiny scale. Under total-parameter matching, dense remains slightly better, though the gap is small and narrows during training. That is useful for pretraining research because it sharpens what a dense-vs-sparse result actually means. If the question is per-token active capacity, sparse routing helps. If the question is total stored capacity, dense is still highly competitive. For scaling studies, architecture search, and small pilot runs, this distinction matters because it changes how one should extrapolate conclusions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup is deliberately controlled. The base stack is a decoder-only, LLaMA-style transformer trained on TinyStories. Everything is held fixed except the FFN module, which is replaced by a Mixtral-style MoE block in the sparse variants. The main sparse recipe uses 4 experts, top-2 routing, dropless dispatch, Switch-style load balancing, and optional router z-loss. The authors explicitly avoid token dropping and capacity truncation so that the comparison stays focused on routing behavior rather than execution shortcuts. The training objective combines next-token cross-entropy with a load-balancing auxiliary loss and an optional router z-loss; the best sparse recipe uses lambda_bal = 1e-2 and lambda_z = 1e-3. Fairness is evaluated in two ways. The active-match dense baseline is width-resized to approximately match the MoE’s per-token active parameter count. The total-match dense baseline is resized to match the MoE’s full stored parameter count. The headline configurations are: dense active-match at about 14.89M parameters, MoE at about 21.06M total and 14.77M active parameters, and dense total-match at about 21.06M parameters. Matching is tight, with less than 1% error for active counts and less than 0.1% for total counts. This makes the interpretation straightforward: if fairness means active routed capacity, MoE wins; if fairness means total capacity, dense still has a slight edge.
summary_en.experiments: There are three main empirical takeaways. First, naive sparse training does not work automatically at tiny scale. Top-1 routing without balancing collapses almost immediately, with most layers sending nearly all tokens to one expert. Second, stable sparse training comes from a small recipe rather than a single trick: Switch-style balancing removes the immediate collapse, top-2 routing delivers the main quality gain over top-1, and router z-loss mostly improves routing behavior and stability diagnostics rather than being the main source of validation-loss improvement. Third, the headline numbers are clean. In the three-seed, full-data comparison, the dense active-match model reaches a best validation loss of 1.6545 ± 0.0012, the MoE reaches 1.5788 ± 0.0020, and the dense total-match model reaches 1.5608 ± 0.00x, slightly better than the MoE. So MoE clearly beats the active-matched dense baseline, but still trails the total-matched dense baseline by a small margin. The paper also shows that the sparse gain comes with healthy routing diagnostics rather than pathological expert collapse. The primary metrics are held-out validation loss and perplexity; throughput and single-GPU dispatch optimizations are treated as appendix-side support rather than core evidence.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and method and make sure the two fairness definitions are clear. Active-parameter matching asks whether conditional computation is better given the same per-token active capacity. Total-parameter matching asks whether sparsity is better given the same stored capacity. Then go straight to the result tables and figures covering top-1 collapse, the effect of load balancing, the gain from top-2 routing, and the role of z-loss. If you only spend 20 to 30 minutes, focus on the headline validation-loss comparison and the routing diagnostics, because together they determine whether the conclusion is trustworthy. If you want more depth, inspect the appendix for dispatch implementation details, throughput analysis, and layerwise expert-usage plots to judge which findings are likely to survive at larger scale and which may change once systems constraints dominate.

recommendation.zh: 值得看实验设计而非结论外推；active-match 赢、total-match 输，会逼你重新写 MoE ablation 的公平性说明。
recommendation.en: Read it for the experimental design, not scale extrapolation; active-match wins and total-match loses force cleaner fairness claims in MoE ablations.

paper.title: Slicing and Dicing: Configuring Optimal Mixtures of Experts
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have become standard in large language models, yet many of their core design choices - expert count, granularity, shared experts, load balancing, token dropping - have only been studied one or two at a time over narrow configuration ranges. It remains an open question whether these choices can be optimized independently, without considering interactions. We present the first systematic study of over 2,000 pretraining runs spanning models up to 6.6B total pa

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 MoE 预训练配置中一个很实际的问题：专家数量、专家粒度、共享专家、异构专家、负载均衡、token dropping 这些设计项能否独立优化，还是存在强交互。过去很多 MoE 结论来自少量配置或单因素实验，很难指导真实训练配方。论文用超过 2000 次预训练实验，把专家总数和专家粒度拆开控制，试图给出更可复用的 MoE 配置原则。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的影响主要在 MoE 配方选择，而不是提出一个新路由器。最有用的结论是：在相同 active parameter 规模下，增加总 MoE 参数通常持续带来收益，即使 total FFN 参数相对 active FFN 参数的比例达到 128；异构专家和 shared generalist 没有超过调好的同构 MoE；负载均衡超参在合理范围内不需要过度调，dropless routing 有小而稳定的收益。这会改变 MoE sweep 的优先级：先定 active scale 下的专家粒度，再按显存和并行约束增加专家总数，而不是把大量预算花在共享专家或复杂异构结构上。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 MoE 设计空间拆成几个可控变量。专家粒度 g 定义为 expert FFN intermediate dimension 与 dense FFN intermediate dimension 的比值。为了 FLOP-match dense FFN，active expert count 设为 k=1/g，使每个 token 激活的 expert 参数量大致保持不变。总专家数 n 独立变化，activation sparsity 定义为 s=n·g，也就是 total FFN 参数相对 active FFN 参数的扩张倍数。这个定义很关键，因为它把“每个专家多大”和“一共有多少专家”分开了。论文还测试了同一层内不同粒度混合的 heterogeneous expert pools，以及 always-active 的 shared generalist expert。路由方面覆盖负载均衡机制、负载均衡权重和 token dropping/dropless routing。与很多已有 MoE 研究不同，这里不是只比较 top-1/top-2 或专家数，而是在固定计算预算下系统扫描容量、稀疏度、粒度和路由稳定性。
summary.experiments: 实验规模覆盖约 10M 到 6.6B total parameters，总计超过 2000 次预训练 run。核心结果有四点。第一，在所有研究过的 active parameter scale 上，增加 total MoE parameters 都能持续改善性能，activation sparsity 到 128 时仍然没有看到明确饱和。第二，专家粒度需要随 active scale 调整；fine-grained experts 的价值不是单独来自更小专家，而是来自在同等 active compute 下可以激活更多专家并扩大总专家池。第三，heterogeneous expert sizing 没有稳定超过 homogeneous MoE，说明让同层专家大小更灵活并不自动带来更好 specialization；shared generalist expert 反而持续伤害性能，可能因为它削弱了路由专家承担通用建模负载的压力，同时占用了固定计算预算。第四，负载均衡超参在合理区间内表现相对鲁棒，dropless routing 比 token dropping 有小幅但一致的提升。给出的内容没有包含每个 benchmark 的具体 loss 或 accuracy 表格，因此不应臆造单项数值。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读三部分。第一，方法部分关于 granularity、active expert count、activation sparsity 的定义，这是理解所有实验公平性的基础。第二，专家数量与粒度的二维 sweep 图表，重点看在 fixed active parameters 下 total experts 增加是否仍改善 loss，以及不同 g 在不同 scale 下的交叉点。第三，heterogeneous experts、generalist experts 和 routing ablation，价值在负结果：复杂结构没有赢过简单同构配置。真正值得深挖的是这些结论和系统约束的关系，例如 expert parallelism、显存放置、all-to-all 通信是否会改变最优点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical configuration problem in MoE pretraining: whether expert count, expert granularity, shared experts, heterogeneous expert sizes, load balancing, and token dropping can be tuned independently. Prior evidence was usually based on narrow one-factor studies, which makes it hard to turn the results into a reliable pretraining recipe.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a large empirical map of the MoE design space rather than a new router. The main finding is actionable: at a fixed active-parameter scale, increasing total MoE parameters consistently improves quality, even when total FFN parameters are 128 times the active FFN parameters. Heterogeneous experts and always-on generalist experts do not beat a well-configured homogeneous MoE, and shared generalists consistently hurt. Load-balancing hyperparameters are relatively robust within reasonable ranges, while dropless routing gives a small consistent gain. For pretraining practice, this shifts the sweep budget toward expert granularity and total expert count, rather than complex expert mixtures or heavy load-balancing tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study separates expert size from expert count. Expert granularity g is defined as the ratio between an expert FFN intermediate dimension and the dense FFN intermediate dimension. To match dense FFN compute, the number of active experts is set to k=1/g, keeping active expert parameters roughly fixed per token. The total number of experts n is varied independently, and activation sparsity is defined as s=n·g, the ratio between total FFN parameters and active FFN parameters. This setup makes it possible to ask whether gains come from smaller experts, more active experts, or a larger inactive expert pool. The paper also evaluates mixed-granularity expert pools within a layer, always-active shared generalist experts, load-balancing variants, load-balancing weights, and token dropping versus dropless routing.
summary_en.experiments: The study reports more than 2,000 pretraining runs, ranging from roughly 10M to 6.6B total parameters. Four results matter most. First, quality improves monotonically with total MoE parameters across all active-parameter scales studied, with improvements still visible at activation sparsity 128. Second, expert granularity must be chosen relative to active scale; fine-grained experts help because they allow more experts to be activated under the same active compute and make a larger expert pool feasible. Third, heterogeneous expert sizes do not provide a stable advantage over homogeneous experts, and shared generalist experts consistently degrade performance. Fourth, routing quality is not overly sensitive to load-balancing hyperparameters in reasonable ranges, while dropless routing gives a small but repeatable benefit. The supplied content does not expose per-benchmark loss or accuracy tables, so exact task-level numbers should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the definitions of granularity, active expert count, and activation sparsity first; they determine whether the comparisons are compute-matched. Then focus on the two-dimensional sweeps over expert count and granularity, especially the curves at fixed active parameters. The ablations on heterogeneous experts, shared generalists, and routing are worth careful attention because the negative results simplify the MoE design space. A useful follow-up question is how these empirical optima interact with systems constraints such as expert parallelism, memory placement, and all-to-all communication.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该认真读：它可能把 MoE 配置搜索从“总参数直觉”改成“active 参数主导”的设计 prior，先看主结论图和各 knob 的交互表，再决定内部 sweep 怎么改。
recommendation.en: This is worth real attention: it may shift MoE design from total-parameter intuition to an active-parameter-centric prior; read the main scaling plots and interaction tables before planning your next sweep.

paper.title: OrScale: Orthogonalised Optimization with Layer-Wise Trust-Ratio Scaling
paper.abstract: Muon improves neural-network training by orthogonalizing matrix-valued updates, but it leaves each layer's update magnitude controlled mostly by a global learning rate. We introduce OrScale, a trust-ratio extension of Muon built on a simple rule: the denominator of a layer-wise ratio should measure the Frobenius norm of the actual parameter-space direction that will be applied. This yields OrScale for general matrix layers and OrScale-LM for language models, where Moonlight shape scaling is comb

summary.core_problem: Muon 优化器通过正交化更新方向，但缺乏像 LARS/LAMB 那样的逐层步长（magnitude）控制，导致在不同层（如注意力、MLP、投影层）梯度尺度差异大时，单一全局学习率无法最优地控制更新幅度。直接将 LAMB 移植到 Muon 会由于正交化丢失幅度信息而导致分母退化、动量截断饱和及权重范数失控。
summary.importance: 提出了一种原则性方法，将逐层信任比（trust-ratio）缩放引入正交化优化器（Muon），解决了 Muon 在 LLM 预训练中步长控制的缺陷。这使得 Muon 能够像 AdamW 一样稳定且高效地进行大规模预训练，并实现了学习率的无缝迁移。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 OrScale 优化器，核心原则是：信任比的分母必须测量优化器实际从参数中减去的真实参数空间方向的 Frobenius 范数。具体而言，如果更新方向是 $\lambda W_{\ell} + s_{\ell}Q_{\ell}$（其中 $W_{\ell}$ 是权重，$Q_{\ell}$ 是正交化后的动量，$s_{\ell}$ 是形状因子），分母就应该精确测量这个表达式的范数。针对 LLM 预训练，提出了 OrScale-LM 变体，结合了 Moonlight 的形状因子 $s_{\ell} = 0.2\sqrt{\max(m_{\ell}, n_{\ell})}$ 和一个逐层校准常数，使得初始信任比严格为 1，从而直接继承 AdamW 调优好的学习率。
summary.experiments: 在 CIFAR-10/DavidNet 上，OrScale 在三个随机种子下均排名第一。在 125M 到 1.1B 参数规模的 FineWeb-Edu 预训练中，OrScale-LM 表现优于基线。消融实验验证了设计空间中其他变体确实会导致理论预测的失败模式（如分母退化、截断饱和）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Section 3 中关于信任比分母设计的核心原则，以及 Section 4 中对三种失败模式（分母退化、截断饱和、权重衰减失控）的理论与实证分析。Algorithm 1 给出了简洁的实现伪代码。

summary_en.core_problem: Muon optimizer orthogonalizes update directions but lacks layer-wise magnitude control like LARS/LAMB. A single global learning rate is suboptimal given the varying gradient scales across different layers (attention, MLP, projections). Naively porting LAMB to Muon fails because orthogonalization removes amplitude information, leading to degenerate denominators, clip-saturated momentum, and runaway weight norms.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a principled approach to incorporate layer-wise trust-ratio scaling into orthogonalized optimizers (Muon), addressing a key limitation in LLM pre-training. This enables Muon to train stably and efficiently at scale, with seamless learning rate transfer from AdamW.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes OrScale, built on the principle that the trust-ratio denominator must measure the Frobenius norm of the actual parameter-space direction subtracted from the weights. If the update is $\lambda W_{\ell} + s_{\ell}Q_{\ell}$ ($W_{\ell}$ is weight, $Q_{\ell}$ is orthogonalized momentum, $s_{\ell}$ is a shape factor), the denominator measures exactly this norm. For LLMs, OrScale-LM combines Moonlight's shape factor $s_{\ell} = 0.2\sqrt{\max(m_{\ell}, n_{\ell})}$ with a layer-wise calibration constant to ensure the initial trust ratio is exactly 1, allowing direct inheritance of AdamW-tuned learning rates.
summary_en.experiments: OrScale ranks first on CIFAR-10/DavidNet across three seeds. In FineWeb-Edu pre-training (125M to 1.1B parameters), OrScale-LM outperforms baselines. Ablations confirm that alternative designs lead to predicted failure modes (degenerate denominators, clip saturation).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the core principle of denominator design, and Section 4 for the theoretical and empirical analysis of the three failure modes. Algorithm 1 provides a concise implementation recipe.

recommendation.zh: 对Muon的一个扎实改进，关键insight是信任比分母应追踪实际更新方向而非代理度量。三种失败模式的分析很有价值，应纳入内部optimizer ablation考虑。
recommendation.en: A solid improvement on Muon with the key insight that trust-ratio denominators should track actual update directions. The three failure-mode analyses are valuable and should inform internal optimizer ablations.

paper.title: When Losses Align: Gradient-Based Composite Loss Weighting for Efficient Pretraining
paper.abstract: Modern deep models are often pretrained on large-scale data with missing labels using composite objectives, where the relative weights of multiple loss terms act as hyperparameters. Tuning these weights with random search or Bayesian optimization is computationally expensive, as it requires many independent training runs. To address this, we propose a gradient-based bilevel method that learns pretraining loss weights online by aligning the composite pretraining gradient with a downstream objecti

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决复合预训练目标中的 loss 权重选择问题。许多预训练任务会同时使用多个 loss，但权重通常依赖人工经验、网格搜索、随机搜索或贝叶斯优化，代价高且难扩展。作者希望在单次训练过程中在线学习这些权重，使预训练梯度更有利于下游目标。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练的直接性不如语言建模论文强，但问题很实用。大模型训练中常见复合目标，例如 next-token loss、denoising loss、contrastive loss、多模态对齐 loss、辅助监督 loss、质量预测 loss 等。权重调参通常需要昂贵试验。该工作给出一种基于梯度对齐的在线调权思路：如果某个预训练 loss 的梯度方向与下游验证目标梯度一致，就提高其权重；反之降低。这个原则可以迁移到多目标预训练和 mid-training 的权重调度。不过实验规模偏小，任务集中在 event-sequence modeling 和自监督视觉，尚未证明能在 LLM 规模稳定工作。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 GraP，即 Gradient-aligned Pretraining。作者将 loss 权重选择写成 bilevel optimization：内层用带权复合预训练 loss 更新模型，外层希望降低带标签子集上的下游 loss。对单步 SGD 展开后，某个 loss 权重 w_k 的超梯度近似为下游梯度与该 loss 梯度的内积；直观上，这是判断一次预训练更新是否会降低下游 loss。直接计算每个 loss 对全模型参数的梯度内积会很贵。GraP 改为在共享表示空间中计算对齐信号，即比较各预训练头和下游头对 backbone 表示 z 的梯度方向，从而避免为每个 loss 做完整 backward。作者还强调归一化不应简单约束权重向量本身，而应约束合成更新向量的范数，因为不同 loss 的梯度尺度可能差异很大。权重限制为非负，以避免对单个预训练目标做梯度上升带来的不稳定。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 event-sequence modeling 和 self-supervised vision。文中声称 GraP 在平均表现上达到或超过手工调参、贝叶斯优化和常见多任务学习权重方法，同时只需要一次训练，额外开销约为单次训练的 30%。相对于贝叶斯搜索，作者报告约 50× 的调参效率提升。消融结论包括：基于梯度对齐的在线权重比固定均匀权重更稳；在共享表示空间计算对齐可以显著降低代价；按更新向量范数归一化比直接归一化权重更合理；方法还能把冗余 loss 的权重压低。需要注意，全文材料中没有显示大模型预训练级别的参数规模或 token 规模实验。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30–40 分钟。优先看 Problem formulation 和 Method，尤其是从 bilevel objective 到单步 SGD 超梯度的推导，以及 representation-space alignment 的近似。实验部分重点看与 Bayesian search、uniform weighting、多任务权重方法的对比，以及 normalization 的消融。对 LLM 预训练研究者，最值得借鉴的是“用下游或 held-out 信号对齐预训练梯度”这一调权机制；最需要保留疑问的是其在大 batch、AdamW、长训练、多数据源和非平稳数据混合中的稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses loss-weight selection for composite pretraining objectives. Many pretraining pipelines combine several losses, but their weights are usually chosen by manual tuning, random search, grid search, or Bayesian optimization. Those approaches require many training runs. The goal is to learn the weights online during a single pretraining run so that the resulting update is better aligned with downstream performance.
summary_en.importance: The connection to foundation-model pretraining is practical rather than specific to language modeling. Large training pipelines often combine next-token prediction, denoising, contrastive objectives, multimodal alignment losses, auxiliary supervision, or quality-related losses. Weight tuning for such mixtures is expensive. The paper provides a clean gradient-alignment principle: increase the weight of a pretraining loss if its gradient points in a direction that reduces a downstream objective, and reduce it otherwise. This idea is relevant for multi-objective pretraining and mid-training schedules. The evidence is still small-scale relative to LLM training, with experiments on event-sequence modeling and self-supervised vision rather than billion-parameter language models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, GraP, frames loss-weight tuning as bilevel optimization. The inner problem updates the model with a weighted sum of pretraining losses. The outer problem measures downstream loss on a labeled subset. For a one-step SGD unroll, the hypergradient for a weight w_k is proportional to the inner product between the downstream gradient and the gradient of the k-th pretraining loss. This gives a direct gradient-alignment signal. Computing full-parameter gradient inner products for every loss would be expensive, so GraP computes the alignment in the shared representation space instead. Each pretraining head and the downstream head produce gradients with respect to the backbone representation z, and these gradients are used to update the loss weights. The paper also argues that normalization should constrain the norm of the resulting update vector, not merely the weight vector, because losses can have very different gradient scales. Weights are kept nonnegative to avoid turning an individual pretraining objective into gradient ascent.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover event-sequence modeling and self-supervised vision. The reported results show that GraP matches or improves over manually tuned baselines, Bayesian optimization, uniform weighting, and common multi-task weighting methods on average, while requiring only one training run. The extra cost is reported to be about 30% over a single run, and the tuning efficiency is reported to be roughly 50× better than Bayesian search. Ablations support several points: online gradient-aligned weighting is better than fixed uniform weighting; representation-space alignment reduces the computational cost; normalizing the update vector is more robust than normalizing weights directly; and the method can assign low weights to redundant loss terms. The provided material does not show LLM-scale parameter counts, token budgets, or long-horizon pretraining runs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Focus on the Problem Formulation and Method sections, especially the derivation from the bilevel objective to the one-step SGD hypergradient and the approximation that moves alignment computation into representation space. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons with Bayesian search, uniform weighting, and multi-task weighting baselines, plus the normalization ablation. For LLM pretraining, the useful idea is using a held-out or downstream signal to align pretraining gradients. The open question is whether this remains stable under AdamW, very large batches, long schedules, changing data mixtures, and noisy downstream proxy signals.

recommendation.zh: 多损失预训练调权重的低成本方案，做预训练多目标 ablation 的可参考§3的梯度推导部分
recommendation.en: Low-cost method for tuning composite loss weights in pretraining, researchers running multi-objective pretraining ablations can refer to the gradient derivation in §3
